## apps/lua/HaloHUD/aero.lua

````lua
-- Approved HTML preview motion, in pure Lua. State lives outside the renderer
-- so layout/cache rebuilds do not restart an in-flight transition.
local M={}
function M.new() return {phase=0,velocity=0} end
function M.update(s,active,dt,durationMS)
  local target=active and 1 or 0
  dt=type(dt)=='number' and dt==dt and math.max(0,math.min(0.05,dt)) or 0
  local w=7/(math.max(150,math.min(1000,durationMS or 420))/1000)
  local offset=s.phase-target
  local b=s.velocity+w*offset
  local decay=math.exp(-w*dt)
  s.phase=target+(offset+b*dt)*decay
  s.velocity=(s.velocity-w*b*dt)*decay
  if s.phase<0 or s.phase>1 then s.phase=math.max(0,math.min(1,s.phase));s.velocity=0 end
  if math.abs(s.phase-target)<0.0001 and math.abs(s.velocity)<0.002 then
    s.phase=target;s.velocity=0
  end
  return s.phase
end
function M.poses(p)
  p=math.max(0,math.min(1,p))
  local angle=math.rad(-45+45*p)
  local thickness=2.2+1.8*p
  return {
    {x=-12+2.5*p,y=8-19*p,length=24+8*p,angle=angle,thickness=thickness},
    {x=12-12*p,y=8-6*p,length=24+27*p,angle=angle,thickness=thickness}}
end
function M.vertices(pose,originU,originV)
  local c,s=math.cos(pose.angle),math.sin(pose.angle)
  local l,h=pose.length/2,pose.thickness/2
  local points={}
  for i,v in ipairs({{-l,-h},{l,-h},{l,h},{-l,h}}) do
    points[i]={originU+pose.x+v[1]*c-v[2]*s,originV+pose.y+v[1]*s+v[2]*c}
  end
  return points
end
return M

````

## apps/lua/HaloHUD/gear_motion.lua

````lua
-- Approved HTML gear animation, pure Lua. Persistent state survives layout rebuilds.
local M={}
function M.new() return {gear=nil,position=0,velocity=0,letter='N',scale=1,phase=nil} end
function M.update(s,gear,dt,duration)
  local target=math.max(0,gear)
  local desired=gear==-1 and 'R' or 'N'
  dt=type(dt)=='number' and dt==dt and math.max(0,math.min(.05,dt)) or 0
  duration=math.max(150,math.min(600,duration or 260))/1000
  if s.gear==nil then
    s.gear=gear;s.position=target;s.letter=desired
  elseif s.gear~=gear then
    if s.gear<=0 and gear<=0 then
      if s.phase==nil then s.phase=0 end
    else s.letter=desired;s.phase=nil;s.scale=1 end
    s.gear=gear
  end
  if s.phase~=nil then
    local previous=s.phase
    s.phase=math.min(1,s.phase+dt/(2*duration))
    s.scale=1+.30*math.sin(math.pi*s.phase)^2
    if previous<.5 and s.phase>=.5 then s.letter=desired end
    if s.phase>=1 then
      s.scale=1
      s.phase=s.letter~=desired and 0 or nil
    end
  else s.scale=1 end
  local w=7/duration;local offset=s.position-target
  local b=s.velocity+w*offset;local decay=math.exp(-w*dt)
  s.position=target+(offset+b*dt)*decay
  s.velocity=(s.velocity-w*b*dt)*decay
  if s.position<0 then s.position=0;s.velocity=0 end
  if math.abs(s.position-target)<.0001 and math.abs(s.velocity)<.002 then
    s.position=target;s.velocity=0
  end
  return s
end
return M

````

## apps/lua/HaloHUD/HaloHUD.lua

````lua
-- HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa 1.10.0, original screen-space artwork. CSP 0.2.0+ (build 2651).
-- Required UI/telemetry calls were checked against the shipped 0.2.0 SDK.
local Telemetry=require('telemetry')
local Settings=require('settings')
local Renderer=require('renderer')
local Aero=require('aero')
local aero=Aero.new()
local GearMotion=require('gear_motion')
local gearMotion=GearMotion.new()
local LeaderboardMotion=require('leaderboard_motion')
local leaderboardMotion=LeaderboardMotion.new()
local cfg, activeCfg, renderer, oldWidth, oldHeight
local state=Telemetry.new()
local demoTime, rowTimer, previousMode = 0, 0, nil
local enabled, forceDemo, profile=false,false,false
local cpu={update=0,draw=0,maxDraw=0,frames=0}
local errorMessage=nil
local statusMessage=nil
local dirty,saveTimer=false,0
local dragMode,dragging=false,false
local function markDirty()
  dirty=true; saveTimer=0.4; statusMessage='Saving settings...'
end
local function saveConfig()
  cfg.enabled=enabled; cfg.profileCPU=profile
  local ok,err=pcall(Settings.save,__dirname..'/config.ini',cfg)
  dirty=not ok; saveTimer=ok and 0 or 2
  errorMessage=not ok and tostring(err) or nil
  statusMessage=ok and 'Saved config.ini.' or nil
end
ac.onRelease(function()
  if cfg and dirty then saveConfig() end
end)

local function loadConfig()
  cfg=Settings.read(ac.INIConfig.load(__dirname..'/config.ini'))
  enabled=cfg.enabled
  forceDemo=cfg.demo=='ON'
  profile=cfg.profileCPU
  dirty=false; saveTimer=0
  renderer=nil; activeCfg=nil; rowTimer=0; errorMessage=nil
  dragging=false
end

-- Only this adapter touches CSP; telemetry.lua can be tested with plain tables.
local function updateTelemetry(dt)
  demoTime=demoTime+math.max(0,dt)
  local sim=ac.getSim()
  local car=sim and sim.carsCount>0 and ac.getCar(0) or nil
  local effective=Settings.effective(cfg,car and ac.getCarID(0) or '',car)
  if not activeCfg or effective.rpmMax~=activeCfg.rpmMax or effective.revLimit~=activeCfg.revLimit
    or effective.gearCount~=activeCfg.gearCount then renderer=nil end
  activeCfg=effective
  local mode=(forceDemo or (not car and cfg.demo~='OFF')) and 'demo' or (car and 'live' or 'empty')
  if mode~=previousMode then
    state=Telemetry.new(); rowTimer=0; previousMode=mode
    aero=Aero.new(); gearMotion=GearMotion.new(); leaderboardMotion=LeaderboardMotion.new()
  end
  if mode=='demo' then Telemetry.demo(state,demoTime,cfg.names)
  elseif mode=='live' then
    Telemetry.sample(state,car,dt,cfg.damping/1000)
    Telemetry.energy(state,dt,activeCfg)
    rowTimer=rowTimer-dt
    if rowTimer<=0 then
      rowTimer=0.25
      local session=ac.getSession(sim.currentSessionIndex)
      if sim.raceSessionType==ac.SessionType.Race or (session and session.type==ac.SessionType.Race) then
        Telemetry.raceRows(state,car,sim.carsCount,function(index)
          return ac.getCar(index)
        end,cfg.names)
      else
        local board=session and session.leaderboard
        Telemetry.rows(state,car,board and #board or 0,function(rank)
          local entry=board and board[rank]
          return entry and entry.car or nil
        end,cfg.names,sim.carsCount)
      end
    end
  end
  state.leaderboardMotion=LeaderboardMotion.update(leaderboardMotion,state,dt,cfg.leaderboardDuration)
  local motion=GearMotion.update(gearMotion,state.gear,dt,cfg.gearDuration)
  state.gearPosition=motion.position;state.slotLetter=motion.letter;state.slotScale=motion.scale
  state.aeroPhase=Aero.update(aero,state.aeroActive,dt,cfg.aeroDuration)
end

function script.update(dt)
  if not cfg then
    local ok,err=pcall(loadConfig)
    if not ok then errorMessage=tostring(err); return end
  end
  -- Run persistence even when the HUD is disabled or controls are closed.
  if dirty then
    saveTimer=saveTimer-math.max(0,dt)
    if saveTimer<=0 then saveConfig() end
  end
  if not enabled then return end
  local start=profile and os.preciseClock() or 0
  updateTelemetry(dt)
  if profile then cpu.update=(os.preciseClock()-start)*1000 end
end

function script.drawHUD()
  if not cfg or not enabled or previousMode=='empty' then dragging=false; return end
  local uiState=ac.getUI()
  -- CSP's own visibility flags follow Ctrl+H and global UI hiding. Do not
  -- change ENABLED: showing the game's HUD again restores our previous state.
  if uiState.appsHidden or uiState.uiHidden then dragging=false; return end
  local screen=uiState.windowSize
  local start=profile and os.preciseClock() or 0
  if not renderer or oldWidth~=screen.x or oldHeight~=screen.y then
    renderer=Renderer.new(activeCfg or cfg,screen.x,screen.y)
    oldWidth,oldHeight=screen.x,screen.y
  end
  -- inputs=false gives a fixed, click-through HUD. Offsets are shared by sliders and the optional drag handle.
  ui.beginTransparentWindow('HaloHUD:overlay',vec2(0,0),screen,true,false)
  renderer.render(state)
  ui.endTransparentWindow()
  if dragMode then
    local info=renderer.drag
    local size=vec2(156,30)
    local pos=vec2(math.max(8,math.min(screen.x-size.x-8,info.anchor.x-size.x/2)),
      math.max(8,math.min(screen.y-size.y-8,info.anchor.y-size.y/2)))
    -- Only the small handle accepts input, never the fullscreen HUD surface.
    ui.beginTransparentWindow('HaloHUD:dragHandle',pos,size,true,true)
    ui.invisibleButton('##HaloHUDDrag',size)
    local held=ui.itemActive()
    if held then
      ui.captureMouse()
      if dragging then
        local delta=ui.mouseDelta()
        if (delta.x~=0 or delta.y~=0) and delta.x==delta.x and delta.y==delta.y
          and math.abs(delta.x)<1e6 and math.abs(delta.y)<1e6 then
          local x=Telemetry.clamp(info.x+delta.x/info.scale,info.minX,info.maxX)
          local y=Telemetry.clamp(info.y+delta.y/info.scale,info.minY,info.maxY)
          if x~=cfg.x or y~=cfg.y then
            cfg.x,cfg.y=x,y
            renderer=nil; markDirty()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    dragging=held
    ui.drawRectFilled(vec2(),size,rgbm(0.025,0.16,0.22,0.96),5)
    ui.setCursor(vec2(12,6));ui.text('Drag HUD')
    ui.endTransparentWindow()
  else dragging=false end
  if profile then
    cpu.draw=(os.preciseClock()-start)*1000
    cpu.maxDraw=math.max(cpu.maxDraw,cpu.draw); cpu.frames=cpu.frames+1
  end
end

function script.windowMain()
  if not cfg then
    ui.textWrapped(errorMessage or 'HaloHUD is loading.'); return
  end
  ui.text('HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa 1.10.0')
  if ui.checkbox('Show HUD',enabled) then enabled=not enabled; markDirty() end
  if ui.checkbox('Force demo telemetry',forceDemo) then
    forceDemo=not forceDemo; cfg.demo=forceDemo and 'ON' or 'AUTO'; markDirty()
  end
  if ui.checkbox('Measure Lua CPU time',profile) then
    profile=not profile; cpu.maxDraw=0; cpu.frames=0
    markDirty()
  end
  local function slider(label,key,lo,hi,fmt)
    local v=ui.slider(label,cfg[key],lo,hi,fmt or '%.2f')
    v=Telemetry.clamp(v,lo,hi)
    if v~=cfg[key] then cfg[key]=v; renderer=nil; markDirty() end
  end
  ui.text('Live layout (automatically fits screen)')
  if ui.checkbox('Drag HUD with mouse',dragMode) then
    dragMode=not dragMode; dragging=false
  end
  if dragMode then
    ui.textWrapped('Hold the Drag HUD handle above the dial and move your mouse. Turn this option off when finished. Position saves automatically.')
  end
  slider('HUD scale','scale',0.5,1.5)
  slider('X offset','x',-960,960,'%.0f px')
  slider('Y offset','y',-540,540,'%.0f px')
  slider('Curvature','curve',0,1.6)
  slider('Leaderboard animation','leaderboardDuration',200,900,'%.0f ms')
  slider('Gear animation','gearDuration',150,600,'%.0f ms')
  slider('Aero animation','aeroDuration',150,1000,'%.0f ms')
  slider('Left timing scale','leftScale',0.5,1.5)
  slider('Center dial scale','dialScale',0.5,1.5)
  slider('Pedal / energy modules scale','moduleScale',0.5,1.5)
  slider('Right powertrain scale','rightScale',0.5,1.5)
  if ui.checkbox('Outer arc',cfg.outerArc) then cfg.outerArc=not cfg.outerArc; renderer=nil; markDirty() end
  if ui.button('Save config.ini') then
    saveConfig()
  end
  if ui.button('Reset to defaults') then
    dragMode=false; dragging=false
    cfg=Settings.read(nil); enabled=cfg.enabled; forceDemo=false; profile=false; renderer=nil
    state=Telemetry.new(); rowTimer=0
    markDirty()
  end
  ui.textWrapped('Changes apply immediately and save automatically after 0.4 seconds without edits. Save writes immediately. Reset restores and saves defaults. Reload reads external edits.')
  if ui.button('Reload config.ini') then
    local ok,err=pcall(loadConfig)
    if not ok then errorMessage=tostring(err) end
  end
  if errorMessage then ui.textWrapped('Config error: '..errorMessage) end
  if statusMessage then ui.textWrapped(statusMessage) end
  if activeCfg and activeCfg.profileActive then
    local p=cfg.carProfile
    ui.textWrapped(p.name..' | '..p.class..' | '..p.bhp..' | '..p.weight)
    ui.textWrapped('Powertrain: '..activeCfg.powertrainSource)
    ui.text(string.format('RPM scale %.0f | limiter %.0f | gears %d',
      activeCfg.rpmMax,activeCfg.revLimit,activeCfg.gearCount))
    ui.textWrapped('Packed car data not exported: battery capacity, recovery calibration and camera remain unverified.')
  end
  ui.text(string.format('Source: %s | physics: %s',previousMode or 'loading',tostring(state.physics)))
  ui.text('Position '..state.player.position..' | '..(state.leaderFirst and 'Behind ' or 'Ahead ')..state.ahead.position..' '..state.ahead.name)
  ui.text(string.format('Speed %.3f km/h | RPM %.0f | Gear %d',state.speed,state.rpm,state.gear))
  ui.text(string.format('Raw brake %.3f | throttle %.3f',state.rawBrake,state.rawThrottle))
  ui.text(string.format('ERS %s | charge %.3f | input %.3f',tostring(state.ers),state.charge,state.ersInput))
  ui.text(string.format('DRS present %s | active %s',tostring(state.aeroPresent),tostring(state.aeroActive)))
  if profile then
    ui.text(string.format('Lua update %.3f ms | draw %.3f ms',cpu.update,cpu.draw))
    ui.text(string.format('Peak draw %.3f ms / %d frames',cpu.maxDraw,cpu.frames))
    ui.textWrapped('CPU submission only. Use CSP profiling and an on/off GPU frame-time comparison for the 0.3 ms target. Exclude initial warm-up.')
  end
  if renderer then ui.text(string.format('Textured quads: %d',renderer.quads)) end
end

````lua
-- Approved vertical leaderboard spring. State persists independently of draw caches.
local M={}
function M.new() return {ready=false,p={x=30.5,v=0},o={x=-49,v=0},a={x=1,v=0},opponent={position='--',name='UNAVAILABLE'}} end
function M.update(s,t,dt,duration)
  local p=t.solo and -11.5 or t.leaderFirst and -53.5 or 30.5
  local o=t.leaderFirst and 30.5 or -49
  local a=t.solo and 0 or 1
  if not t.solo then s.opponent.position=t.ahead.position;s.opponent.name=t.ahead.name end
  dt=type(dt)=='number' and dt==dt and math.max(0,math.min(.05,dt)) or 0
  local w=7/(math.max(200,math.min(900,duration or 450))/1000)
  for key,target in pairs({p=p,o=o,a=a}) do
    local axis=s[key]
    if not s.ready then axis.x=target;axis.v=0 end
    local d=axis.x-target;local b=axis.v+w*d;local decay=math.exp(-w*dt)
    axis.x=target+(d+b*dt)*decay;axis.v=(axis.v-w*b*dt)*decay
    if math.abs(axis.x-target)<.0001 and math.abs(axis.v)<.002 then axis.x=target;axis.v=0 end
  end
  s.ready=true
  s.opponentAlpha=math.max(0,math.min(1,s.a.x))*math.min(1,math.abs(s.o.x-s.p.x)/55)
  return s
end
return M

````

## apps/lua/HaloHUD/renderer.lua

````lua
-- Single drawing API: CSP 0.2.0 ui.drawImageQuad(). All static and dynamic
-- geometry uses the same projection, so moving CURVE never separates the labels.
local glyphs = require('glyphs')
local Aero = require('aero')
local M = {}
local whiteTexture = 'assets/white.png'
local PEDAL_SEGMENTS = 16 -- fit denser bars in the existing module envelope
local themes = {
  TEAL = {accent={47,224,208}, secondary={159,184,200}, blue={30,123,255}, green={43,227,122}},
  ICE = {accent={58,184,232}, secondary={169,198,219}, blue={30,123,255}, green={80,240,183}},
  AMBER = {accent={255,194,71}, secondary={215,192,153}, blue={30,123,255}, green={43,227,122}}
}
local function rgba(c,a) return rgbm(c[1]/255,c[2]/255,c[3]/255,a or 1) end

function M.new(cfg, width, height)
  local self={cfg=cfg, static={}, textCache={}, cacheCount=0, quads=0}
  local theme=themes[cfg.theme] or themes.TEAL
  local opacity=cfg.opacity
  self.c={accent=rgba(theme.accent,opacity), dim=rgba(theme.secondary,opacity),
    blue=rgba(theme.blue,opacity), green=rgba(theme.green,opacity),
    white=rgba({255,255,255},opacity), glass=rgba({255,255,255},opacity),
    inactive=rgba({52,79,91},opacity*.7), brake=rgba({255,64,56},opacity),
    black=rgba({6,24,43},opacity), glow=rgba({124,255,176},opacity*.3)}
  local ds,ms,ls,rs=cfg.dialScale or 1,cfg.moduleScale or 1,cfg.leftScale or 1,cfg.rightScale or 1
  local inner=175+180*(ds-1) -- preserve default shape, reflow as the dial changes
  local sideInner=inner+133*ms+10
  local radius=cfg.curve>0.0001 and 1650/cfg.curve or nil
  local function region(u,flat)
    if flat then return 'dial' end
    return math.abs(u)>=318 and (u<0 and 'left' or 'right') or 'module'
  end
  local function localPoint(u,v,flat,group)
    group=group or region(u,flat)
    if group=='curvedModule' then
      -- Keep gauge radii centered on the dial, independent of halo curvature.
      local r=math.sqrt(u*u+v*v)
      local k=(180*ds+(r-180)*ms)/r
      return u*k,v*k
    end
    if group=='dial' then u=u*ds; v=v*ds
    elseif group=='module' then
      u=(u<0 and -1 or 1)*(inner+(math.abs(u)-175)*ms); v=v*ms
    elseif group=='left' then u=-sideInner+(u+318-(v+82)*10/172)*ls; v=v*ls
    elseif group=='right' then u=sideInner+(u-318)*rs; v=v*rs end
    if flat or not radius then return u,v end
    local a=u/radius
    return (radius-v)*math.sin(a),radius-(radius-v)*math.cos(a)
  end
  local arcEnd=sideInner+522*math.max(ls,rs)
  local arcV=-math.max(196,180*ds+20,150*math.max(ls,rs,ms)+20)
  -- Conservative region envelopes include dynamic labels and battery.
  -- Fit the complete composition, then clamp offsets so controls cannot clip it.
  local minX,maxX,minY,maxY=0,0,0,0
  local function bounds(u,v,flat,g)
    local x,y=localPoint(u,v,flat,g)
    minX=math.min(minX,x);maxX=math.max(maxX,x)
    minY=math.min(minY,y);maxY=math.max(maxY,y)
  end
  for _,r in ipairs({{-840,-318,-145,130,'left'}, {318,840,-100,130,'right'},
      {-310,-160,-150,150,'curvedModule'}, {160,310,-150,150,'curvedModule'},
      {-184,184,-205,230,'dial'}}) do
    for i=0,64 do for _,v in ipairs({r[3],r[4]}) do
      bounds(r[1]+(r[2]-r[1])*i/64,v,r[5]=='dial',r[5])
    end end
  end
  if cfg.outerArc then for i=0,96 do bounds(-arcEnd+2*arcEnd*i/96,arcV,false,'arc') end end
  local s=math.min(math.min(width/1920,height/1080)*cfg.scale,
    (width-32)/(maxX-minX),(height-32)/(maxY-minY))
  local ox=math.max(16-minX*s,math.min(width-16-maxX*s,width/2+cfg.x*s))
  local oy=math.max(16-minY*s,math.min(height-16-maxY*s,height/2+(cfg.y-5)*s))
  function self.point(u,v,flat,group)
    local x,y=localPoint(u,v,flat,group)
    return vec2(ox+x*s,oy+y*s)
  end
  -- Mouse deltas use CSP UI pixels. Convert through the actual fitted scale,
  -- and start from the visible position (not a previously clamped request).
  self.drag={anchor=self.point(0,-214,true),scale=s,
    x=(ox-width/2)/s,y=(oy-height/2)/s+5,
    minX=math.max(-960,(16-minX*s-width/2)/s),
    maxX=math.min(960,(width-16-maxX*s-width/2)/s),
    minY=math.max(-540,(16-minY*s-height/2)/s+5),
    maxY=math.min(540,(height-16-maxY*s-height/2)/s+5)}
  function self.quad(u,v,w,h,texture,uv,flat,group)
    uv=uv or {0,0,1,1}; group=group or region(u+w/2,flat)
    return {texture or whiteTexture,
      self.point(u,v,flat,group),self.point(u+w,v,flat,group),self.point(u+w,v+h,flat,group),self.point(u,v+h,flat,group),
      vec2(uv[1],uv[2]),vec2(uv[3],uv[2]),vec2(uv[3],uv[4]),vec2(uv[1],uv[4])}
  end

  function self.draw(q,color,alpha)
    self.quads=self.quads+1
    if alpha then color=rgbm(color.r,color.g,color.b,color.mult*alpha) end
    ui.drawImageQuad(q[1],q[2],q[3],q[4],q[5],color,q[6],q[7],q[8],q[9])
  end

  function self.rect(u,v,w,h,color,flat)
    self.draw(self.quad(u,v,w,h,nil,nil,flat),color)
  end

  function self.image(texture,u,v,w,h,color,flat,strips)
    strips=strips or 1
    for i=0,strips-1 do
      self.draw(self.quad(u+w*i/strips,v,w/strips,h,texture,{i/strips,0,(i+1)/strips,1},flat),color)
    end
  end

  -- Text meshes are cached by complete string and location. The cache is bounded
  -- and reset in one small batch to avoid unbounded growth in long sessions.
  function self.text(str,u,v,size,color,style,align,maxWidth,flat,tracking,group)
    group=group or region(u,flat)
    str=tostring(str); style=style or 'labels'; tracking=tracking or 1
    local key=table.concat({str,u,v,size,style,align or '',maxWidth or 0,flat and 1 or 0,tracking,group},'|')
    local mesh=self.textCache[key]
    if not mesh then
      local font=glyphs[style]; local scale=size/font.cap; local width=0
      for i=1,#str do
        local g=font.glyphs[tostring(str:byte(i))] or font.glyphs['63']
        width=width+g.advance*scale+tracking
      end
      width=math.max(0,width-tracking)
      if maxWidth and width>maxWidth then
        local f=maxWidth/width; scale=scale*f; tracking=tracking*f; width=maxWidth
      end
      local x=u-(align=='center' and width/2 or align=='right' and width or 0)
      mesh={}
      for i=1,#str do
        local g=font.glyphs[tostring(str:byte(i))] or font.glyphs['63']
        if str:byte(i)~=32 then
          mesh[#mesh+1]=self.quad(x+g.x*scale,v+(g.y+font.cap)*scale,g.w*scale,g.h*scale,font.texture,g.uv,flat,group)
        end
        x=x+g.advance*scale+tracking
      end
      if self.cacheCount>=512 then self.textCache={}; self.cacheCount=0 end
      self.textCache[key]=mesh; self.cacheCount=self.cacheCount+1
    end
    for i=1,#mesh do self.draw(mesh[i],color) end
  end

  -- All gauge artwork shares a 640x320 design atlas centered at (0,0).
  -- Crop UVs instead of stretching a shorter fill; outlines retain their shape.
  local function gaugeQuad(side,top,bottom,texture)
    local u=side==1 and -310 or 160
    return self.quad(u,top,150,bottom-top,texture,
      {(u+320)/640,(top+160)/320,(u+470)/640,(bottom+160)/320},false,'curvedModule')
  end
  local function energyLabels()
    for side,label in ipairs({'RECHARGE','DEPLOY'}) do
      local sign=side==1 and -1 or 1
      local span=side==1 and 44 or 26
      for i=1,#label do
        local a=math.rad(-span/2+span*(i-1)/(#label-1))
        self.text(label:sub(i,i),sign*206*math.cos(a),206*math.sin(a)-4,
          10,self.c.white,nil,'center',nil,false,1,'curvedModule')
      end
    end
  end

  -- Capture static draw calls once: no extra canvas allocation, shader compilation,
  -- filesystem reads or per-frame rendering of glow layers.
  local originalDraw=self.draw
  self.draw=function(q,color,alpha) self.static[#self.static+1]={q,color,alpha} end
  local c=self.c; local n=cfg.strips
  self.image('assets/left_fill.png',-830,-92,512,192,c.glass,false,n)
  self.image('assets/left_rim.png',-830,-92,512,192,c.accent,false,n)
  self.image('assets/right_fill.png',318,-92,512,192,c.glass,false,n)
  self.image('assets/right_rim.png',318,-92,512,192,c.accent,false,n)
  for side=1,2 do
    self.draw(gaugeQuad(side,-150,150,'assets/curved_pedal_fill.png'),rgba({18,52,66},opacity))
    self.draw(gaugeQuad(side,-150,150,'assets/curved_pedal_rim.png'),c.accent)
    self.draw(gaugeQuad(side,-150,150,'assets/curved_energy_rim.png'),rgba({50,150,194},opacity))
    self.draw(gaugeQuad(side,-150,150,'assets/curved_energy_fill.png'),rgba({10,50,112},opacity))
  end
  self.text('BRAKE',-246,127,12,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,false,1,'curvedModule')
  self.text('THROTTLE',246,127,12,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,false,1,'curvedModule')
  self.image('assets/dial_fill.png',-180,-180,360,360,c.glass,true)
  self.image('assets/dial_rim.png',-180,-180,360,360,c.accent,true)
  self.text('ACTIVE',347,-62,12,c.white)
  self.text('AERO',347,-44,12,c.white)
  self.text('GEARS',620,-57,12,c.dim,nil,'center')
  self.text('RPM x1000',624,108,12,c.dim,nil,'center')
  for i=0,15 do
    local u=430+i*24
    self.rect(u,62,1.2,5,c.dim)
    if i%3==0 then self.text(string.format('%g',i*cfg.rpmMax/15000),u,72,9,c.dim,nil,'center') end
  end
  -- Exactly the same image rectangle, strip boundaries, projection and skew
  -- as the timing panel; the alpha mask contains the constant-inset row outline.
  -- The row highlight is selected dynamically below (lower row or solo center).
  if cfg.outerArc then
    for i=0,95 do
      local u=-arcEnd+2*arcEnd*i/96
      self.draw(self.quad(u,arcV,2*arcEnd/96+0.2,1.5,nil,nil,false,'arc'),c.accent,0.65)
    end
  end
  self.draw=originalDraw

  self.highlights={regular={},solo={},leader={}}
  for mode,texture in pairs({regular='assets/player_highlight.png',solo='assets/player_highlight_solo.png',leader='assets/player_highlight_leader.png'}) do
    for i=0,n-1 do
      self.highlights[mode][i+1]=self.quad(-830+512*i/n,-92,512/n,192,texture,{i/n,0,(i+1)/n,1})
    end
  end

  self.pedals={}; self.rpm={}; self.gears={}
  for side=1,2 do
    self.pedals[side]={}
    for i=1,PEDAL_SEGMENTS do
      local bottom=110-(i-1)*220/PEDAL_SEGMENTS
      self.pedals[side][i]=gaugeQuad(side,bottom-220/PEDAL_SEGMENTS+2,bottom,'assets/curved_pedal_segments.png')
    end
  end
  for i=1,48 do self.rpm[i]=self.quad(430+(i-1)*7.5,46,7.7,5) end
  local gearCount=math.max(1,math.min(12,cfg.gearCount or 8))
  local gearStep=344/gearCount
  local gearBox=math.min(36,gearStep-4)
  for gear=0,gearCount do self.gears[gear]=self.quad(454+gear*gearStep-gearBox/2,-24,gearBox,43) end
  self.chargeBg=self.quad(-64,178,128,48,'assets/battery.png',nil,true)

  function self.render(t)
    self.quads=0
    for i=1,#self.static do local q=self.static[i]; self.draw(q[1],q[2],q[3]) end
    local board=t.leaderboardMotion
    if board then
      -- Crop the existing approved mask to the row, and move all projected strips
      -- through the same skew/curve as the panel. Transparent atlas margins are excluded.
      for i=0,n-1 do
        self.draw(self.quad(-830+512*i/n,board.p.x-18.5,512/n,68,
          'assets/player_highlight.png',{i/n,104/192,(i+1)/n,172/192}),c.accent)
      end
    else
    local highlight=self.highlights[t.leaderFirst and 'leader' or t.solo and 'solo' or 'regular']
    for i=1,#highlight do self.draw(highlight[i],c.accent) end
    end
    for side,value in ipairs({t.brake,t.throttle}) do
      for i=1,PEDAL_SEGMENTS do
        self.draw(self.pedals[side][i],c.inactive)
        local f=math.max(0,math.min(1,value*PEDAL_SEGMENTS-(i-1)))
        if f>0 then self.draw(self.pedals[side][i],side==1 and c.brake or c.green,f) end
      end
    end
    -- Continuous bottom-up fill inside the rounded energy mask.
    local top=-206*math.sin(math.rad(27))-23
    local bottom=-top
    for side,value in ipairs({t.recharge or 0,t.deploy or 0}) do
      value=math.max(0,math.min(1,value))
      if value>0 then self.draw(gaugeQuad(side,bottom-(bottom-top)*value,bottom,
        'assets/curved_energy_fill.png'),rgba({70,180,255},opacity)) end
    end
    energyLabels()
    local kmh=math.floor(t.speed+0.5); local mph=math.floor(t.speed*0.6213711922+0.5)
    local mphFirst=cfg.units=='MPH'
    self.text(mphFirst and 'MPH' or 'KM/H',0,-127,13,c.white,nil,'center',nil,true)
    self.text(tostring(mphFirst and mph or kmh),0,-99,49,c.white,nil,'center',236,true,1)
    -- Highlight BOOST from the displayed deploy gauge, with the same damping.
    -- Exactly 50% remains plain; DRS/P2P fallback deploy is eligible too.
    local function inactiveBox(v)
      local border=rgba({125,139,148},opacity*0.8)
      self.rect(-112,v,224,27,rgba({65,75,83},opacity*0.55),true)
      self.rect(-112,v,224,1.5,border,true)
      self.rect(-112,v+25.5,224,1.5,border,true)
      self.rect(-112,v,1.5,27,border,true)
      self.rect(110.5,v,1.5,27,border,true)
    end
    if (t.deploy or 0)>0.5 then
      self.image('assets/boost_glow.png',-124,-27,248,48,c.glow,true)
      self.rect(-112,-18,224,27,c.green,true)
      self.rect(-112,-18,224,1.5,c.green,true)
      self.rect(-112,7.5,224,1.5,c.green,true)
      self.text('BOOST',0,-11,12,c.white,nil,'center',205,true,2)
    else
      inactiveBox(-18)
      self.text('BOOST',0,-11,12,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,true,2)
    end
    inactiveBox(14)
    self.text(t.ers and 'OVERTAKE' or 'NO ERS',0,21,12,c.dim,nil,'center',205,true,2)
    self.text(tostring(mphFirst and kmh or mph),0,57,38,c.white,nil,'center',205,true)
    self.text(mphFirst and 'KM/H' or 'MPH',0,110,12,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,true)
    self.draw(self.chargeBg,rgba({5,15,26},opacity)) -- empty battery silhouette remains visible without KERS
    if t.ers then
      if t.charge>0 then self.draw(self.quad(-64,178,128*t.charge,48,'assets/battery.png',{0,0,t.charge,1},true),rgba({46,212,255},opacity)) end
      self.image('assets/bolt.png',-10,186,16,30,c.white,true)
    else self.text('--',0,193,13,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,true) end
    if board then
      local alpha=board.opponentAlpha
      if alpha>0.001 then
        local dim=rgbm(c.dim.r,c.dim.g,c.dim.b,opacity*alpha)
        local white=rgbm(1,1,1,opacity*alpha)
        self.text(board.opponent.position,-779,board.o.x+2,23,dim,'names')
        self.text(board.opponent.name,-723,board.o.x,29,white,'names',nil,354)
      end
      self.text(t.player.position,-779,board.p.x+4,23,c.accent,'names')
      self.text(t.player.name,-723,board.p.x,31,c.accent,'names',nil,354)
    else
    if t.leaderFirst then
      self.text(t.player.position,-779,-49.5,23,c.accent,'names')
      self.text(t.player.name,-723,-53.5,31,c.white,'names',nil,354)
      self.text(t.ahead.position,-779,34.5,23,c.dim,'names')
      self.text(t.ahead.name,-723,30.5,29,c.white,'names',nil,354)
    else
    if not t.solo then
      self.text(t.ahead.position,-779,-47,23,c.dim,'names')
      self.text(t.ahead.name,-723,-49,29,c.white,'names',nil,300)
    end
    local rowOffset=t.solo and -42 or 0
    self.text(t.player.position,-779,34.5+rowOffset,23,c.accent,'names')
    self.text(t.player.name,-723,30.5+rowOffset,31,c.white,'names',nil,354)
    end
    end
    -- DRS is a proxy for the reference's active-aero icon, not universal active aero.
    local phase=t.aeroPhase
    if phase==nil then phase=t.aeroActive and 1 or 0 end -- static fixtures
    local idle=t.aeroAvailable and c.accent or c.dim
    local aeroColor=rgbm(idle.r+(c.green.r-idle.r)*phase,
      idle.g+(c.green.g-idle.g)*phase,idle.b+(c.green.b-idle.b)*phase,opacity)
    -- Both lines rotate clockwise / -> horizontal. Their ordering stays fixed:
    -- left becomes short/upper, right becomes long/lower, exactly as approved.
    for _,pose in ipairs(Aero.poses(phase)) do
      local v=Aero.vertices(pose,373.5,0)
      local q={whiteTexture}
      for i=1,4 do q[i+1]=self.point(v[i][1],v[i][2],false,'right') end
      q[6],q[7],q[8],q[9]=vec2(0,0),vec2(1,0),vec2(1,1),vec2(0,1)
      self.draw(q,aeroColor)
    end
    local position=t.gearPosition
    if position~=nil then
      position=math.max(0,math.min(gearCount,position))
      local u=454+position*gearStep
      -- Use the same projected quad as the existing gear row, moving continuously.
      local q=position==math.floor(position) and self.gears[position] or
        self.quad(u-gearBox/2,-24,gearBox,43)
      self.draw(q,c.accent,.32)
    end
    for gear=0,gearCount do
      local u=454+gear*gearStep
      local reverse=gear==0 and t.gear==-1
      local selected=t.gear==gear or reverse
      if position==nil and selected then self.draw(self.gears[gear],c.accent,.32) end
      local weight=position~=nil and math.max(0,1-math.abs(gear-position)) or (selected and 1 or 0)
      local size=20+5*weight
      local pulse=gear==0 and (t.slotScale or 1) or 1
      local label=gear==0 and (t.slotLetter or (reverse and 'R' or 'N')) or tostring(gear)
      local color=rgbm(c.dim.r+(c.white.r-c.dim.r)*weight,
        c.dim.g+(c.white.g-c.dim.g)*weight,c.dim.b+(c.white.b-c.dim.b)*weight,opacity)
      -- Expand about the glyph center instead of shifting its baseline down.
      self.text(label,u,-12-size*(pulse-1)/2,size*pulse,color,nil,'center',(gearStep-5)*pulse)
    end
    if t.gear>gearCount then self.text(t.gear,820,26,24,c.white,nil,'center') end
    local rpm=math.max(0,math.min(1,t.rpm/cfg.rpmMax))*48
    for i=1,48 do
      self.draw(self.rpm[i],c.inactive)
      local f=math.max(0,math.min(1,rpm-(i-1)))
      if f>0 then
        local z=(i-1)/47
        local atLimit=t.rpm>11000
        self.draw(self.rpm[i],atLimit and rgbm(1,0.25,0.22,opacity*f) or
          rgbm((47-4*z)/255,(224+3*z)/255,(208-86*z)/255,opacity*f))
      end
    end
    if t.demo then self.text('DEMO',0,-188,8,rgba({159,184,200},opacity*0.45),nil,'center',nil,true,2)
    elseif not t.physics then self.text('PHYSICS N/A',0,244,10,c.dim,nil,'center',nil,true) end
  end
  return self
end
return M

````

````lua
-- One schema for defaults, compatibility reads, range clamps and saving.
local M={}
M.schema={
  enabled={'ENABLED',true}, scale={'SCALE',1,0.5,1.5}, x={'X_OFFSET',0,-960,960},
  y={'Y_OFFSET',0,-540,540}, curve={'CURVE',1,0,1.6}, opacity={'OPACITY',0.95,0,1},
  leftScale={'LEFT_SCALE',1,0.5,1.5}, dialScale={'DIAL_SCALE',1,0.5,1.5},
  moduleScale={'MODULE_SCALE',1,0.5,1.5}, rightScale={'RIGHT_SCALE',1,0.5,1.5},
  outerArc={'OUTER_ARC',false}, aeroDuration={'AERO_ANIMATION_MS',420,150,1000},
  leaderboardDuration={'LEADERBOARD_ANIMATION_MS',450,200,900},
  gearDuration={'GEAR_ANIMATION_MS',260,150,600},
  profileCPU={'PROFILE_CPU',false}, units={'UNITS','KMH'}, names={'DRIVER_NAMES','FULL'},
  theme={'THEME','TEAL'}, demo={'DEMO','AUTO'}, damping={'PEDAL_DAMPING_MS',70,1,500},
  energyDamping={'ENERGY_DAMPING_MS',70,60,80}, recoveryMax={'RECOVERY_MAX_RATE',0.10,0.001,10},
  recoveryWindow={'RECOVERY_WINDOW_MS',250,50,2000},
  recoveryFallback={'RECOVERY_FALLBACK','BRAKE'}, noKersDeploy={'NO_KERS_DEPLOY','DRS_OR_P2P'},
  p2pActiveStatus={'P2P_ACTIVE_STATUS',-1,-1,255},
  gearCount={'GEAR_COUNT',8,1,12}, revLimit={'REV_LIMIT_RPM',0,0,30000},
  rpmMax={'RPM_MAX',15000,1000,30000}, strips={'CURVE_STRIPS',12,8,32}}
M.profileSection='CAR_PROFILE_FORMULA_ULTRA_26'
-- Confirmed readable metadata. -1 means NOT FOUND, not a car specification.
M.profileSchema={enabled={'ENABLED',true}, carId={'CAR_ID','formula_ultra_26'},
  name={'NAME','Formula Ultra 2026'}, class={'CLASS','race'}, bhp={'UI_BHP','950 bhp'},
  torque={'UI_TORQUE','575Nm'}, weight={'UI_WEIGHT','768kg*'},
  speed={'UI_TOP_SPEED','350+km/h'}, acceleration={'UI_ACCELERATION','2s 0-100'},
  ratio={'UI_POWER_WEIGHT','0.81 kg/hp'}, lcd={'DISPLAY_MESH','LCD'},
  script={'DISPLAY_SCRIPT','SF24_Display_script.lua'},
  live={'USE_LIVE_POWERTRAIN',true}, rpmMax={'RPM_MAX',-1,-1,30000},
  revLimit={'REV_LIMIT_RPM',-1,-1,30000}, gears={'GEARS',-1,-1,12},
  recoveryMax={'RECOVERY_MAX_RATE',-1,-1,10}, capacity={'BATTERY_CAPACITY_KJ',-1,-1,1000000}}
local function clean(v,d)
  if type(d[2])=='number' then
    if type(v)~='number' or v~=v or math.abs(v)==math.huge then v=d[2] end
    return math.max(d[3],math.min(d[4],v))
  end
  return type(v)=='string' and v:upper() or v
end
function M.read(ini)
  local c={}
  for k,d in pairs(M.schema) do
    local v=d[2]
    if ini then v=ini:get('HUD',d[1],d[2]) end
    c[k]=clean(v,d)
  end
  c.strips=math.floor(c.strips)
  c.p2pActiveStatus=math.floor(c.p2pActiveStatus)
  c.carProfile={}
  for k,d in pairs(M.profileSchema) do
    local v=d[2]
    if ini then v=ini:get(M.profileSection,d[1],d[2]) end
    -- Metadata/path casing is significant: do not uppercase profile strings.
    c.carProfile[k]=type(d[2])=='string' and v or clean(v,d)
  end
  return c
end
function M.effective(c,id,car)
  local e={}; for k,v in pairs(c) do e[k]=v end
  local p=c.carProfile
  e.profileActive=p and p.enabled and id==p.carId or false
  e.powertrainSource='generic configuration'
  if e.profileActive then
    local live=p.live and car and car.physicsAvailable~=false
    local limiter=live and car.rpmLimiter or 0
    local gears=live and car.gearCount or 0
    if p.rpmMax>0 then e.rpmMax=p.rpmMax
    elseif type(limiter)=='number' and limiter>0 then e.rpmMax=limiter end
    if p.revLimit>0 then e.revLimit=p.revLimit
    elseif type(limiter)=='number' and limiter>0 then e.revLimit=limiter end
    if p.gears>0 then e.gearCount=math.floor(p.gears)
    elseif type(gears)=='number' and gears>0 then e.gearCount=math.floor(gears) end
    e.gearCount=math.max(1,math.min(12,e.gearCount))
    if p.recoveryMax>0 then e.recoveryMax=p.recoveryMax end
    e.powertrainSource=live and 'live CSP / explicit profile overrides' or 'generic fallback / explicit profile overrides'
  end
  return e
end
function M.save(path,c)
  -- Preserve unknown keys/other sections; never replace the file with a subset.
  local ini=ac.INIConfig.load(path)
  for k,d in pairs(M.schema) do ini:set('HUD',d[1],clean(c[k],d)) end
  for k,d in pairs(M.profileSchema) do
    local v=c.carProfile[k]
    ini:set(M.profileSection,d[1],type(d[2])=='string' and v or clean(v,d))
  end
  ini:save(path)
end
return M

````

## apps/lua/HaloHUD/telemetry.lua

````lua
-- Pure Lua: intentionally independent of CSP so edge cases can be tested offline.
local M = {}
local function finite(x, fallback)
  return type(x) == 'number' and x == x and math.abs(x) < math.huge and x or (fallback or 0)
end
function M.clamp(x, lo, hi) return math.max(lo or 0, math.min(hi or 1, finite(x))) end

-- ASCII font atlas: normalize common Latin surnames, use ? for other code points.
local accents = {['ä']='A',['á']='A',['à']='A',['â']='A',['ã']='A',['å']='A',
  ['Ä']='A',['Á']='A',['À']='A',['Â']='A',['Ã']='A',['Å']='A',
  ['é']='E',['è']='E',['ê']='E',['ë']='E',['É']='E',['È']='E',['Ê']='E',['Ë']='E',
  ['í']='I',['ì']='I',['î']='I',['ï']='I',['Í']='I',['Ì']='I',['Î']='I',['Ï']='I',
  ['ö']='O',['ó']='O',['ò']='O',['ô']='O',['õ']='O',['Ö']='O',['Ó']='O',['Ò']='O',['Ô']='O',
  ['ü']='U',['ú']='U',['ù']='U',['û']='U',['Ü']='U',['Ú']='U',['Ù']='U',['Û']='U',
  ['ñ']='N',['Ñ']='N',['ç']='C',['Ç']='C',['ß']='SS',['ø']='O',['Ø']='O',['ł']='L',['Ł']='L'}
function M.name(raw, mode)
  local s = tostring(raw or '')
  for a, b in pairs(accents) do s = s:gsub(a, b) end
  s = s:gsub('[\194-\244][\128-\191]*', '?'):upper():gsub('[^ -~]', '')
  s = s:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  s = s:match('([^%s]+)$') or 'DRIVER'
  if mode == 'CODE' then return s:sub(1, 3) end
  return #s > 19 and s:sub(1, 18)..'.' or s
end

function M.new()
  return {speed=0, rpm=0, gear=0, brake=0, throttle=0, rawBrake=0, rawThrottle=0,
    ers=false, charge=0, ersInput=0, charging=false, overtake=false,
    deploy=0, recharge=0, rawDeploy=0, rawRecharge=0, solo=false, leaderFirst=false,
    aeroPresent=false, aeroActive=false, aeroAvailable=false, physics=false, demo=false,
    ahead={position='--', name='CLEAR TRACK'}, player={position='--', name='DRIVER'}}
end

function M.sample(out, car, dt, tau)
  out.demo = false
  out.speed = math.max(0, finite(car.speedKmh))
  out.rpm = math.max(0, finite(car.rpm))
  out.gear = math.floor(finite(car.gear))
  out.physics = car.physicsAvailable ~= false
  out.rawBrake = out.physics and M.clamp(car.brake) or 0
  out.rawThrottle = out.physics and M.clamp(car.gas) or 0
  local a = 1 - math.exp(-math.max(0, finite(dt)) / math.max(0.001, tau))
  out.brake = out.brake + (out.rawBrake - out.brake) * a
  out.throttle = out.throttle + (out.rawThrottle - out.throttle) * a
  out.ers = out.physics and car.kersPresent == true
  out.charge = out.ers and M.clamp(car.kersCharge) or 0
  out.chargeValid = type(car.kersCharge)=='number' and car.kersCharge==car.kersCharge
    and car.kersCharge>=0 and car.kersCharge<=1
  -- This is CSP's normalized KERS input, not a claim of measured motor kW.
  out.ersInput = out.ers and M.clamp(car.kersInput) or 0
  out.charging = out.ers and car.kersCharging == true
  -- OVERTAKE means the explicit button is pressed, not guessed from throttle.
  out.overtake = out.ers and car.kersButtonPressed == true
  out.aeroPresent = out.physics and car.drsPresent == true
  out.aeroActive = out.aeroPresent and car.drsActive == true
  out.aeroAvailable = out.aeroPresent and car.drsAvailable == true
  -- SDK declares p2pStatus but not its enum values. Only a user-specified active
  -- value may enable this fallback; -1 in settings means unknown/disabled.
  out.p2pStatus = out.physics and finite(car.p2pStatus,-1) or -1
  return out
end

-- Charge fraction/second, not power or lap-budget usage. Quantized telemetry is
-- accumulated across unchanged frames; a timeout activates the explicit fallback.
function M.energy(out,dt,cfg)
  dt=finite(dt)
  local target=0
  if dt>0 and dt<=0.5 and out.ers and out.charging and out.chargeValid then
    if out._lastCharge and out._wasCharging then
      out._elapsed=(out._elapsed or 0)+dt
      local delta=out.charge-out._lastCharge
      if delta~=0 then
        out._rate=math.max(0,delta)/math.max(dt,out._elapsed)
        out._elapsed=0; out._measured=true
      elseif out._elapsed >= cfg.recoveryWindow/1000 then
        out._measured=false; out._rate=0
      end
    else out._measured=false; out._rate=0; out._elapsed=0 end
    if out.charge>=1 then target=0
    elseif out._measured then target=M.clamp(out._rate/cfg.recoveryMax)
    elseif cfg.recoveryFallback=='BRAKE' then target=out.rawBrake end
  elseif out.ers and out.charging and not out.chargeValid and cfg.recoveryFallback=='BRAKE' then
    target=out.rawBrake
  else out._measured=false; out._rate=0; out._elapsed=0 end
  -- Ignore pause/seek/long-frame derivatives; baseline is always advanced.
  if dt<=0 or dt>0.5 then target=0; out._measured=false; out._elapsed=0 end
  out._lastCharge=out.chargeValid and out.charge or nil
  out._wasCharging=out.charging
  out.rawRecharge=target
  local fallback=cfg.noKersDeploy=='DRS' or cfg.noKersDeploy=='DRS_OR_P2P'
  local p2p=cfg.noKersDeploy=='DRS_OR_P2P' and (cfg.p2pActiveStatus or -1)>=0
    and out.p2pStatus==cfg.p2pActiveStatus
  out.rawDeploy=out.ers and out.ersInput or
    (out.physics and fallback and (out.aeroActive or p2p) and 1 or 0)
  local a=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/(cfg.energyDamping/1000))
  out.recharge=out.recharge+(target-out.recharge)*a
  out.deploy=out.deploy+(out.rawDeploy-out.deploy)*a
  if not out.ers then
    out.recharge=0
    if not fallback or not out.physics then out.deploy=0 end
  end
end

-- Called at 4 Hz, separate from graphics-rate telemetry. CSP's leaderboard order
-- handles race positions and practice/qualifying lap-time rankings consistently.
function M.rows(out, player, count, atRank, mode, carCount)
  out.leaderFirst=false
  -- The simulation count distinguishes a solo session from P1 or a partially
  -- populated leaderboard. Older callers can supply just the leaderboard count.
  out.solo = (carCount or count)==1
  out.ahead.position, out.ahead.name = '--', 'CLEAR TRACK'
  if out.solo then out.ahead.position, out.ahead.name = '', '' end
  out.player.position = out.solo and '1' or '--'
  out.player.name = M.name(player:driverName(), mode)
  local previous, previousRank = nil, nil
  for rank = 0, math.max(0, finite(count)) - 1 do
    local other = atRank(rank)
    if other then
      if other.index == player.index then
        out.player.position = tostring(rank + 1)
        if previous then
          out.ahead.position = tostring(previousRank + 1)
          out.ahead.name = M.name(previous:driverName(), mode)
        end
        return
      end
      previous, previousRank = other, rank
    end
  end
  -- No populated leaderboard yet: keep the real name, leave rank unavailable.
end

-- Race classification must use each car's live racePosition, never its index
-- in session.leaderboard (which can keep the player first in AI races).
-- The comparison row holds P2 when leading, otherwise the driver at P-1.
function M.raceRows(out, player, count, getCar, mode)
  out.solo=count==1
  out.leaderFirst=false
  out.player.name=M.name(player:driverName(),mode)
  local position=finite(player.racePosition)
  if position<1 or position~=math.floor(position) then position=out.solo and 1 or 0 end
  out.player.position=position>0 and tostring(position) or '--'
  out.ahead.position,out.ahead.name='--','UNAVAILABLE'
  if out.solo then out.ahead.position,out.ahead.name='','';return end
  if position<1 then return end
  out.leaderFirst=position==1
  local otherPosition=out.leaderFirst and 2 or position-1
  for i=0,count-1 do
    local other=getCar(i)
    if other and other.index~=player.index and other.isConnected~=false
      and other.isActive~=false and finite(other.racePosition)==otherPosition then
      out.ahead.position=tostring(otherPosition)
      out.ahead.name=M.name(other:driverName(),mode)
      return
    end
  end
end

function M.demo(out, t, mode)
  out.solo=false
  out.leaderFirst=false
  out.demo, out.physics, out.ers, out.aeroPresent = true, true, true, true
  out.speed = 180 + 116 * math.sin(t * 0.65)
  out.rpm = 7900 + 6900 * math.sin(t * 0.81)
  out.gear = math.min(8, math.floor((math.sin(t * 0.39) + 1) * 5) - 1) -- R,N,1..8
  out.brake = (math.sin(t * 1.7) + 1) / 2
  out.throttle = (math.sin(t * 1.7 + math.pi) + 1) / 2
  out.rawBrake, out.rawThrottle = out.brake, out.throttle
  out.charge = (math.sin(t * 0.4) + 1) / 2
  out.ersInput = out.throttle
  out.deploy = out.throttle
  out.recharge = out.brake>0.55 and out.brake or 0
  out.charging = out.brake > 0.55
  out.overtake = math.sin(t * 0.8) > 0.3
  out.aeroActive = math.sin(t * 0.6) > 0
  out.aeroAvailable = true
  out.ahead = {position='12', name=M.name('Oliver Bearman', mode)}
  out.player = {position='13', name=M.name('George Russell', mode)}
  return out
end
return M

````

````ini
; Formula Ultra 2026 — pending loose cameras.ini and car.ini export.
; This is intentionally a comment-only merge guide, not an executable camera.
; No position, FOV, pitch or CAMERA_n index is invented.
;
; Once supplied:
; 1. Preserve existing camera sections and append the next contiguous CAMERA_n.
; 2. Derive POSITION from the confirmed halo mount / driver-eye transforms.
; 3. Derive orthogonal FORWARD and UP from the verified optical pitch.
; 4. Use the exported FOV or an explicitly chosen and tested replacement.
; 5. Project the LCD bind-pose geometry through that camera and align the HUD.
; 6. Verify in AC: halo clearance, front wheels/nose, LCD visibility and DEMO.
;
; Available evidence: extension/ext_config.ini attaches SF24_Display_script.lua
; to the LCD mesh. DISPLAY_POS=0,0 is a texture origin, not a car-local camera.
; Actual KN5 bind-pose bounds and inspection limits: ../CAR-PROFILE.md.
; Neither this file nor HaloHUD edits the installed car.

## previews/Aero-animation-preview.html

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa — Aero motion preview</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Orbitron;src:url('source/fonts/Orbitron.ttf')}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#15232c;color:#e4f3f5;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif}
main{max-width:900px;margin:40px auto;padding:24px}h1{font-size:26px;margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:600}
p{line-height:1.5;color:#a8bec9;max-width:740px}svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;background:#1e303c;margin:24px 0}
button{background:#153d4b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #2fe0d0;border-radius:5px;padding:11px 18px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}
.controls{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}input{accent-color:#2fe0d0}label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}small{color:#9fb8c8}#seek{width:220px}#duration{width:150px}
@media(max-width:600px){main{margin:8px auto;padding:16px}h1{font-size:22px}#seek{width:170px}}
</style>
<main>
<h1>Active aero · animation preview</h1>
<p>Both slashes rotate clockwise 45° to activate, and counterclockwise to deactivate. They stay parallel and separate: the left slash becomes the short upper dash, and the right becomes the long lower dash.</p>
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 300" role="img" aria-label="Animated aero symbol in a curved navy HUD panel">
 <defs><linearGradient id="panel" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#102d40"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#06182b"/></linearGradient></defs>
 <path d="M64 60 Q395 25 736 85 L725 265 Q395 205 55 248Z" fill="url(#panel)" stroke="#2fe0d0" stroke-opacity=".6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
 <g transform="translate(285 130) scale(2.7)">
  <text x="-24" y="-18" fill="#fff" font-family="Orbitron, sans-serif" font-size="5.8">ACTIVE AERO</text>
  <g id="left"><line id="leftLine" stroke-linecap="butt" stroke-width="1.8"/></g>
  <g id="right"><line id="rightLine" stroke-linecap="butt" stroke-width="1.8"/></g>
 </g>
 <text id="state" x="520" y="155" fill="#9fb8c8" font-family="Orbitron,sans-serif" font-size="17">INACTIVE</text>
 <text x="520" y="187" fill="#9fb8c8" font-family="system-ui" font-size="13">Magnified motion study</text>
</svg>
<div class="controls">
 <button id="toggle" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Activate aero</button>
 <label><input id="loop" type="checkbox" checked> Auto loop</label>
 <label>Duration <input id="duration" type="range" min="150" max="1000" step="10" value="420"><output id="ms">420 ms</output></label>
 <label>Scrub <input id="seek" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0"><output id="percent">0%</output></label>
</div>
<p><small>Approved motion reference: this animation is now implemented in HaloHUD 1.5. A damped transition preserves position and velocity when toggled mid-motion. Duration controls the approximate settling time. Reduced-motion preference disables automatic playback and snaps manual toggles; scrubbing remains available.</small></p>
</main>
<script>
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id),left=byId('left'),right=byId('right');
const leftLine=byId('leftLine'),rightLine=byId('rightLine'),state=byId('state');
const toggle=byId('toggle'),loop=byId('loop'),duration=byId('duration'),seek=byId('seek');
const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
let phase=0,velocity=0,target=0,moving=false,lastTime=performance.now(),loopAt=lastTime+1100;
if(reduced)loop.checked=false;
function paint(p){
 const mix=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*p;
 // Preserve line ordering along their shared normal. Both rotate identically.
 // Assign left -> upper short and right -> lower long to avoid intersecting paths.
 const poses=[[-12,8,-9.5,-11,-45+45*p,mix(24,32)], [12,8,0,2,-45+45*p,mix(24,51)]];
 [left,right].forEach((g,i)=>{
   const [x,y,tx,ty,angle,length]=poses[i];
   g.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${mix(x,tx)} ${mix(y,ty)}) rotate(${angle})`);
   const line=i===0?leftLine:rightLine;
   line.setAttribute('x1',-length/2);line.setAttribute('x2',length/2);line.setAttribute('y1',0);line.setAttribute('y2',0);
   line.setAttribute('stroke-width',mix(2.2,4));
   line.setAttribute('stroke',`rgb(${mix(47,43)} ${mix(224,227)} ${mix(208,122)})`);
 });
 seek.value=Math.round(p*1000);byId('percent').textContent=Math.round(p*100)+'%';
 state.textContent=p<.001?'INACTIVE':p>.999?'ACTIVE':target?'ACTIVATING':'DEACTIVATING';
 state.setAttribute('fill',p>.999?'#2be37a':'#9fb8c8');
}
function go(next,now=performance.now()){
 target=next;moving=Math.abs(target-phase)>0.00001&&!reduced;lastTime=now;
 toggle.textContent=target?'Deactivate aero':'Activate aero';toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed',!!target);
 if(!moving){phase=target;velocity=0;paint(phase)}
 loopAt=moving?Infinity:now+1100;
}
toggle.onclick=()=>go(target?0:1);
duration.oninput=()=>{byId('ms').textContent=duration.value+' ms'};
seek.oninput=()=>{moving=false;velocity=0;loop.checked=false;phase=+seek.value/1000;paint(phase)};
loop.onchange=()=>{loopAt=performance.now()+500};
function tick(now){
 const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(0.05,(now-lastTime)/1000));lastTime=now;
 if(moving){
   // Exact critically damped spring step: no reset of velocity during reversals.
   const w=7/(+duration.value/1000),offset=phase-target,b=velocity+w*offset;
   const decay=Math.exp(-w*dt);
   phase=target+(offset+b*dt)*decay;velocity=(velocity-w*b*dt)*decay;
   if(phase<0||phase>1){phase=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,phase));velocity=0}
   if(Math.abs(phase-target)<0.0001&&Math.abs(velocity)<0.002){phase=target;velocity=0;moving=false;loopAt=now+1100}
   paint(phase);
 }
 if(!moving&&loop.checked&&now>=loopAt)go(target?0:1,now);
 requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
paint(0);requestAnimationFrame(tick);
</script></html>

15385],[972.23077,355.15385]],[0.6235294117647059,0.7215686274509804,0.7843137254901961,0.4275],[[0.94091796875,0.2919921875],[0.97119140625,0.2919921875],[0.97119140625,0.3447265625],[0.94091796875,0.3447265625]]]]},"images":{"assets/left_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/left_rim.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/right_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/right_rim.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/module_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/module_rim.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/tab.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/labels.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/dial_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/dial_rim.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/white.png":"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAIAAAACCAYAAABytg0kAAAAFUlEQVR4nGP8////fwYGBgYmEAHCAD34BABm6tHAAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC","review/player_highlight_leader.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/tab_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","review/battery_fill.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/bolt.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/names.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/player_highlight.png":"data:image/png;base64,","assets/player_highlight_solo.png":"data:image/png;base64,"}};const cv=document.getElementById('hud'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');const textures={},cache=new Map();
const scenario=document.getElementById('scenario'),brake=document.getElementById('brake'),battery=document.getElementById('battery'),animate=document.getElementById('animate');let playing=false;
function tinted(name,c){
 const key=name+'|'+c.join(',');if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
 const im=textures[name],can=document.createElement('canvas');can.width=im.width;can.height=im.height;
 const x=can.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(im,0,0);const d=x.getImageData(0,0,can.width,can.height);
 for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]*=c[0];d.data[i+1]*=c[1];d.data[i+2]*=c[2];d.data[i+3]*=c[3];}
 x.putImageData(d,0,0);cache.set(key,can);return can;
}
function tri(im,p,t,ids){
 const [a,b,c]=ids.map(i=>p[i]),[u,v,w]=ids.map(i=>[t[i][0]*im.width,t[i][1]*im.height]);
 const det=u[0]*(v[1]-w[1])+v[0]*(w[1]-u[1])+w[0]*(u[1]-v[1]);if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)return;
 function coeff(j){return [
 (a[j]*(v[1]-w[1])+b[j]*(w[1]-u[1])+c[j]*(u[1]-v[1]))/det,
 (a[j]*(w[0]-v[0])+b[j]*(u[0]-w[0])+c[j]*(v[0]-u[0]))/det,
 (a[j]*(v[0]*w[1]-w[0]*v[1])+b[j]*(w[0]*u[1]-u[0]*w[1])+c[j]*(u[0]*v[1]-v[0]*u[1]))/det];}
 const X=coeff(0),Y=coeff(1);ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a);ctx.lineTo(...b);ctx.lineTo(...c);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();
 ctx.transform(X[0],Y[0],X[1],Y[1],X[2],Y[2]);ctx.drawImage(im,0,0);ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,1920,650);ctx.fillStyle='#24333e';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1920,650);ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-300);
 document.getElementById('brakeValue').textContent=brake.value+'%';document.getElementById('batteryValue').textContent=battery.value+'%';
 for(const cmd of DATA.cases[scenario.value]){let [name,p,c,t,tag]=cmd;let alpha=1;
  if(tag&&tag.startsWith('brake:'))alpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(+brake.value/100)*16-(+tag.split(':')[1]-1)));
  if(!alpha)continue;
  if(tag==='battery'){const f=+battery.value/100;if(!f)continue;p=p.map(v=>v.slice());t=t.map(v=>v.slice());for(const i of [1,2]){p[i][0]=p[0][0]+(p[i][0]-p[0][0])*f;t[i][0]*=f;}}
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;const im=tinted(name,c);tri(im,p,t,[0,1,2]);tri(im,p,t,[0,2,3]);
 }ctx.restore();}
function stop(){playing=false;animate.textContent='Animate values'}
brake.oninput=battery.oninput=()=>{stop();draw()};scenario.onchange=draw;animate.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;animate.textContent=playing?'Pause animation':'Animate values'};
Promise.all(Object.entries(DATA.images).map(([k,url])=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{textures[k]=im;resolve()};im.onerror=reject;im.src=url}))).then(()=>{draw();requestAnimationFrame(function tick(ms){if(playing){brake.value=Math.round((Math.sin(ms/700)+1)*50);battery.value=Math.round((Math.sin(ms/1600)+1)*50);draw()}requestAnimationFrame(tick)});});
</script></html>

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa — curved gauges</title>
<style>@font-face{font-family:Orbitron;src:url('../source/fonts/Orbitron.ttf')}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#101d26;color:#eef9fc;font:15px system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1580px;margin:auto;padding:28px}h1{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:#abc1cb;line-height:1.6;max-width:900px}canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;background:#24333e;border:1px solid #3b515e;margin:20px 0}fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:24px 0;display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}input{accent-color:#3ab8e8;width:140px}output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:4ch}button{font:inherit;background:#15394b;color:white;border:1px solid #688994;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#205269}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2fe0d0;outline-offset:5px}::selection{background:#235b6d;color:#fff}@media(max-width:650px){main{padding:16px}h1{font-size:21px}fieldset{gap:16px}label{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}}</style>
<main><h1>HaloHUD — curved pedal and energy gauges</h1><p>Continuous blue RECHARGE and DEPLOY arcs hug the speedometer. All 16 brake and throttle segments have equal horizontal lengths, with the outer contour adjusted to fit. Labels sit just below the bars, and the battery uses a dark depleted body and bright cyan charge fill. Wider energy arcs sit closer to the dial, with matching curved pedal borders and labels above. Approved visual reference — integrated in Lua app version 1.8.0.</p>
<canvas id="hud" width="1920" height="650" aria-label="HaloHUD curved gauge preview"></canvas>
<fieldset id="controls" aria-label="Synthetic values"></fieldset><fieldset><button id="animate">Animate gauges</button><button id="empty">Empty</button><button id="full">Full</button><button id="reset">Reference values</button><button id="background">Gray background</button></fieldset>

function tinted(name,c){
 const key=name+'|'+c.join(',');if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
 const im=textures[name],can=document.createElement('canvas');can.width=im.width;can.height=im.height;
 const x=can.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(im,0,0);const d=x.getImageData(0,0,can.width,can.height);
 for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]*=c[0];d.data[i+1]*=c[1];d.data[i+2]*=c[2];d.data[i+3]*=c[3];}
 x.putImageData(d,0,0);cache.set(key,can);return can;
}
function tri(im,p,t,ids){
 const [a,b,c]=ids.map(i=>p[i]),[u,v,w]=ids.map(i=>[t[i][0]*im.width,t[i][1]*im.height]);
 const det=u[0]*(v[1]-w[1])+v[0]*(w[1]-u[1])+w[0]*(u[1]-v[1]);if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)return;
 function coeff(j){return [
 (a[j]*(v[1]-w[1])+b[j]*(w[1]-u[1])+c[j]*(u[1]-v[1]))/det,
 (a[j]*(w[0]-v[0])+b[j]*(u[0]-w[0])+c[j]*(v[0]-u[0]))/det,
 (a[j]*(v[0]*w[1]-w[0]*v[1])+b[j]*(w[0]*u[1]-u[0]*w[1])+c[j]*(u[0]*v[1]-v[0]*u[1]))/det];}
 const X=coeff(0),Y=coeff(1);ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a);ctx.lineTo(...b);ctx.lineTo(...c);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();
 ctx.transform(X[0],Y[0],X[1],Y[1],X[2],Y[2]);ctx.drawImage(im,0,0);ctx.restore();
}


function path(r,start,end,side,color,width,cap='butt'){
 ctx.beginPath();const n=72;
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const a=(start+(end-start)*i/n)*Math.PI/180,x=960+side*r*Math.cos(a),y=535+r*Math.sin(a);i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y)}
 ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.lineCap=cap;ctx.stroke();
}

function energy(side,key){
 path(206,27,-27,side,'#3296c2',50,'round');path(206,27,-27,side,'#0a3270',46,'round');
 const v=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,state[key]));
 // Clip a bright, rounded track with a bottom-up horizontal fill surface.
 // This removes the square remnants and keeps rounding at every fill level.
 ctx.save();
 const top=535-206*Math.sin(27*Math.PI/180)-23;
 const bottom=535+206*Math.sin(27*Math.PI/180)+23;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(960-260,bottom-(bottom-top)*v,520,(bottom-top)*v);ctx.clip();
 path(206,27,-27,side,'#46b4ff',46,'round');ctx.restore();
 ctx.font='700 12px Orbitron';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
 key.toUpperCase().split('').forEach((letter,i,arr)=>{const span=key==='deploy'?26:44;const a=(-span/2+span*i/(arr.length-1))*Math.PI/180;ctx.fillText(letter,960+side*206*Math.cos(a),539+206*Math.sin(a))});
}
// A close-fitting annular frame with small corner radii, not capsule ends.
function pedalFrame(side){
 // Offset the outer contour horizontally so every segment stays the same length.
 const pts=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=72;i++){const y=-114+228*i/72;pts.push([960+side*(Math.sqrt(241*241-y*y)+54),535+y])}
 for(let i=0;i<=72;i++){const y=114-228*i/72;pts.push([960+side*Math.sqrt(241*241-y*y),535+y])}
 const near=(a,b,d)=>{const length=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);const f=Math.min(d/length,.45);return [a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*f,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*f]};
 ctx.beginPath();
 pts.forEach((v,i)=>{const before=near(v,pts[(i+pts.length-1)%pts.length],3),after=near(v,pts[(i+1)%pts.length],3);i?ctx.lineTo(...before):ctx.moveTo(...before);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(...v,...after)});
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#123442';ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#2fe0d0';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.stroke();
}
// Both edges share a horizontal offset: each band is exactly 50px long at every height.
function pedalSegment(side,index,color){
 const step=220/16,bottom=110-index*step,top=bottom-step+2;
 ctx.beginPath();
 for(let j=0;j<=8;j++){const y=top+(bottom-top)*j/8;const x=960+side*(Math.sqrt(243*243-y*y)+50);j?ctx.lineTo(x,535+y):ctx.moveTo(x,535+y)}
 for(let j=0;j<=8;j++){const y=bottom+(top-bottom)*j/8;ctx.lineTo(960+side*Math.sqrt(243*243-y*y),535+y)}
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();
}
function draw(dt=.016){
 ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle=grayBackground?'#85888c':'#24333e';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1920,650);ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-300);
 for(const cmd of DATA.cases.leader){let [name,p,c,t,tag]=cmd;const x=p.reduce((a,v)=>a+v[0],0)/4-960,y=p.reduce((a,v)=>a+v[1],0)/4-535;
 if(name==='assets/tab.png'||name==='assets/tab_fill.png'||name==='assets/module_fill.png'||name==='assets/module_rim.png')continue;
 if(Math.abs(x)>184&&Math.abs(x)<318&&y>-165&&y<160)continue;
 if(name==='review/battery_fill.png'){
   if(tag==='battery'){
     const f=state.battery;if(f<.001)continue;
     p=p.map(v=>v.slice());t=t.map(v=>v.slice());
     for(const i of [1,2]){p[i][0]=p[0][0]+(p[i][0]-p[0][0])*f;t[i][0]*=f;}
     c=[.18,.83,1,1];
   }else c=[.02,.06,.10,1];
 }
 const im=tinted(name,c);tri(im,p,t,[0,1,2]);tri(im,p,t,[0,2,3]);}
 for(const key of keys){const target=+document.getElementById(key).value/100;state[key]+=(target-state[key])*(1-Math.exp(-dt/.07));document.getElementById(key+'Out').value=Math.round(target*100)+'%'}
 for(const side of [-1,1]){
 energy(side,side<0?'recharge':'deploy');
 const key=side<0?'brake':'throttle';
 // Two-pixel radial inset and subtle 3px corner rounding.
 pedalFrame(side);
 for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
 pedalSegment(side,i,'#254b58');
 ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,state[key]*16-i));
 pedalSegment(side,i,side<0?'#ff4038':'#2be37a');ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
 ctx.font='12px Orbitron';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#9fb8c8';ctx.fillText(key.toUpperCase(),960+side*246,671);
 }ctx.restore();
}
document.getElementById('background').onclick=()=>{grayBackground=!grayBackground;document.getElementById('background').textContent=grayBackground?'Dark background':'Gray background'};
function stop(){playing=false;document.getElementById('animate').textContent='Animate gauges'}
keys.forEach(k=>document.getElementById(k).oninput=stop);
document.getElementById('animate').onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;document.getElementById('animate').textContent=playing?'Pause animation':'Animate gauges'};
for(const [id,values] of Object.entries({empty:[0,0,0,0,0],full:[100,100,100,100,100],reset:initial}))document.getElementById(id).onclick=()=>{stop();keys.forEach((k,i)=>document.getElementById(k).value=values[i])};
Promise.all([document.fonts.ready,...Object.entries(DATA.images).map(([k,url])=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{textures[k]=im;resolve()};im.onerror=reject;im.src=url}))]).then(()=>requestAnimationFrame(function tick(ms){const dt=last?Math.min(.05,(ms-last)/1000):1/60;last=ms;if(playing)keys.forEach((k,i)=>document.getElementById(k).value=Math.round(50+50*Math.sin(ms/(800+i*230)+i*1.4)));draw(dt);requestAnimationFrame(tick)}));
</script></html>

const cv=document.getElementById('hud'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const seek=document.getElementById('seek'),play=document.getElementById('play');
const bg=document.getElementById('bg');let playing=true,frame=0,last=0;
const textures={},cache=new Map();
function tinted(name,c){
 const key=name+'|'+c.join(',');if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
 const im=textures[name],can=document.createElement('canvas');can.width=im.width;can.height=im.height;
 const x=can.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(im,0,0);const d=x.getImageData(0,0,can.width,can.height);
 for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]*=c[0];d.data[i+1]*=c[1];d.data[i+2]*=c[2];d.data[i+3]*=c[3];}
 x.putImageData(d,0,0);cache.set(key,can);return can;
}
function tri(im,p,t,ids){
 const [a,b,c]=ids.map(i=>p[i]),[u,v,w]=ids.map(i=>[t[i][0]*im.width,t[i][1]*im.height]);
 const det=u[0]*(v[1]-w[1])+v[0]*(w[1]-u[1])+w[0]*(u[1]-v[1]);if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)return;
 function coeff(j){return [
 (a[j]*(v[1]-w[1])+b[j]*(w[1]-u[1])+c[j]*(u[1]-v[1]))/det,
 (a[j]*(w[0]-v[0])+b[j]*(u[0]-w[0])+c[j]*(v[0]-u[0]))/det,
 (a[j]*(v[0]*w[1]-w[0]*v[1])+b[j]*(w[0]*u[1]-u[0]*w[1])+c[j]*(u[0]*v[1]-v[0]*u[1]))/det];}
 const X=coeff(0),Y=coeff(1);ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a);ctx.lineTo(...b);ctx.lineTo(...c);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();
 ctx.transform(X[0],Y[0],X[1],Y[1],X[2],Y[2]);ctx.drawImage(im,0,0);ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,1920,1080);ctx.fillStyle=bg.value;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1920,1080);
 for(const id of DATA.frames[frame]){const [name,p,c,t]=DATA.pool[id],im=tinted(name,c);tri(im,p,t,[0,1,2]);tri(im,p,t,[0,2,3]);}seek.value=frame;}
play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;play.textContent=playing?'Pause demo':'Play demo'};
seek.oninput=()=>{frame=+seek.value;draw()};bg.oninput=draw;
Promise.all(Object.entries(DATA.images).map(([name,url])=>new Promise(resolve=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{textures[name]=im;resolve()};im.src=url}))).then(()=>{
 draw();requestAnimationFrame(function tick(t){if(playing&&t-last>=1000/12){frame=(frame+1)%DATA.frames.length;draw();last=t}requestAnimationFrame(tick)});
});</script>

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa — gear slide preview</title>
<style>@font-face{font-family:Orbitron;src:url('../source/fonts/Orbitron.ttf')}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#101d26;color:#eef9fc;font:15px system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1580px;margin:auto;padding:28px}h1{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:#abc1cb;line-height:1.6;max-width:900px}.stage{border:1px solid #3b515e;background:#24333e;margin:22px 0}svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}text{font-family:Orbitron,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.controls{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}button,select{font:inherit;background:#15394b;color:white;border:1px solid #688994;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:5px}button{cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#205269}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}input{accent-color:#2fe0d0}output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:5ch}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2fe0d0;outline-offset:4px}::selection{background:#235b6d;color:white}@media(max-width:650px){main{padding:16px}h1{font-size:21px}.controls{gap:12px}}</style>
<main><h1>HaloHUD — sliding gear selection</h1><p>The highlight slides right on upshifts and left on downshifts, following the gear row’s curve. Rapid shifts preserve its position and velocity for a seamless change of direction. Approved visual reference; integrated in Lua version 1.9.0.</p>
<div class="stage"><svg id="hud" viewBox="0 300 1920 650" role="img" aria-label="HUD with animated horizontal gear selection"><image href="data:image/png;base64," width="1920" height="1080"/><g id="gears"><polygon id="selection" fill="#2fe0d0" fill-opacity=".32"/><g id="digits"></g></g></svg></div>
<div class="controls"><button id="down">Downshift</button><label>Gear <select id="gear" aria-label="Target gear"></select></label><button id="up">Upshift</button><button id="auto">Auto shift</button><label>Slide duration <input id="duration" type="range" min="150" max="600" value="260" step="10"><output id="durationOut">260 ms</output></label></div>
<p id="status" role="status">Selected gear: 3</p><p>Choose any gear to test skipped shifts, or alternate Upshift/Downshift quickly. N ↔ R gently enlarges the first-slot letter by 30% over twice the slide duration, switches at the peak, then settles back. The highlight stays in the same slot. Auto shift uses synthetic values. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.</p></main><script>
const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',select=document.getElementById('gear'),marker=document.getElementById('selection'),digits=document.getElementById('digits');
const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let gear=3,position=3,velocity=0,playing=false,last=0,nextAuto=0,direction=1;
let slotLetter="N",swapPhase=null,slotScale=1;
for(let value=-1;value<=8;value++){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=value;o.textContent=value===-1?'R':value===0?'N':value;select.append(o)}select.value=3;
const glyphs=[];for(let i=0;i<=8;i++){const n=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');n.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');n.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','middle');n.textContent=i===0?'N':i;digits.append(n);glyphs.push(n)}
// This is the current renderer's default right-panel projection, in design pixels.
function point(u,v){const r=1650,a=u/r;return [960+(r-v)*Math.sin(a),535+r-(r-v)*Math.cos(a)]}
function setGear(value){
 const previous=gear;gear=Math.max(-1,Math.min(8,Number(value)));select.value=gear;
 const desired=gear===-1?'R':'N';
 if(reduced.matches){position=Math.max(0,gear);velocity=0;slotLetter=desired;swapPhase=null;slotScale=1}
 else if(previous<=0&&gear<=0&&previous!==gear){if(swapPhase===null)swapPhase=0}
 else if(previous!==gear){slotLetter=desired;swapPhase=null;slotScale=1}
 document.getElementById('status').textContent='Selected gear: '+(gear<0?'R':gear===0?'N':gear);
 document.getElementById('down').disabled=gear===-1;document.getElementById('up').disabled=gear===8;
}
function stepSlot(dt){
 const desired=gear===-1?'R':'N';
 if(reduced.matches){slotLetter=desired;swapPhase=null;slotScale=1;return}
 if(swapPhase===null){slotScale=1;return}
 const previous=swapPhase;
 swapPhase=Math.min(1,swapPhase+dt/(2*Number(document.getElementById('duration').value)/1000));
 slotScale=1+.30*Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*swapPhase),2);
 // Change the letter only at the enlargement peak. Rapid retargets are queued
 // through the same pulse, rather than snapping its scale back to the start.
 if(previous<.5&&swapPhase>=.5)slotLetter=desired;
 if(swapPhase>=1){slotScale=1;swapPhase=slotLetter!==desired?0:null}
}
function stop(){playing=false;document.getElementById('auto').textContent='Auto shift'}
select.onchange=()=>{stop();setGear(select.value)};
document.getElementById('up').onclick=()=>{stop();setGear(gear+1)};
document.getElementById('down').onclick=()=>{stop();setGear(gear-1)};
document.getElementById('auto').onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;nextAuto=0;document.getElementById('auto').textContent=playing?'Pause auto shift':'Auto shift'};
document.getElementById('duration').oninput=e=>document.getElementById('durationOut').value=e.target.value+' ms';
function step(dt){stepSlot(dt);const target=Math.max(0,gear);if(reduced.matches){position=target;velocity=0;return}
 // Analytic critically damped spring: reversals never restart or snap the box.
 const w=7/(Number(document.getElementById('duration').value)/1000),offset=position-target,b=velocity+w*offset,decay=Math.exp(-w*dt);
 position=target+(offset+b*dt)*decay;velocity=(velocity-w*b*dt)*decay;
 if(position<0||position>8){position=Math.max(0,Math.min(8,position));velocity=0}
 if(Math.abs(position-target)<.0001&&Math.abs(velocity)<.002){position=target;velocity=0}}
function render(){const u=454+43*position;marker.setAttribute('points',[[u-18,-24],[u+18,-24],[u+18,19],[u-18,19]].map(([x,y])=>point(x,y).join(',')).join(' '));
 glyphs.forEach((n,i)=>{const x=454+43*i,p=point(x,4),weight=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(i-position));n.textContent=i===0?slotLetter:i;n.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${p[0]} ${p[1]}) rotate(${x/1650*180/Math.PI})`);n.setAttribute('font-size',(20+5*weight)*(i===0?slotScale:1));n.setAttribute('fill',`rgb(${Math.round(159+96*weight)},${Math.round(184+71*weight)},${Math.round(200+55*weight)})`)})}
function tick(ms){const dt=last?Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,(ms-last)/1000)):0;last=ms;if(playing&&ms>=nextAuto){if(gear>=8)direction=-1;if(gear<=-1)direction=1;setGear(gear+direction);nextAuto=ms+1000}step(dt);render();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
setGear(3);render();requestAnimationFrame(tick);
</script></html>
````

````html
<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>HaloHUD — vertical leaderboard animation</title><style>@font-face{font-family:Orbitron;src:url('../source/fonts/Orbitron.ttf')}@font-face{font-family:Names;src:url('../source/fonts/BarlowCondensed-BoldItalic.ttf')}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#101d26;color:#eef9fc;font:15px system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1580px;margin:auto;padding:28px}h1{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:#abc1cb;line-height:1.6;max-width:900px}.stage{border:1px solid #3b515e;background:#24333e;margin:22px 0}svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}text{font-family:Orbitron,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.controls{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}button,select{font:inherit;background:#15394b;color:white;border:1px solid #688994;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:5px}button{cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#205269}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}input{accent-color:#2fe0d0}output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:5ch}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2fe0d0;outline-offset:4px}::selection{background:#235b6d;color:white}@media(max-width:650px){main{padding:16px}h1{font-size:21px}.controls{gap:12px}}</style>
<main><h1>HaloHUD — sliding leaderboard</h1><p>Player and opponent rows slide vertically when the order changes. The highlight stays attached to the player along the panel’s curve. Mid-animation reversals keep the motion continuous. Approved visual reference; integrated in Lua version 1.10.0.</p>
<div class="stage"><svg viewBox="0 300 1920 650" role="img" aria-label="HUD with vertically animated leaderboard"><image href="data:image/png;base64," width="1920" height="1080"/><defs><clipPath id="panelClip"><path id="clipShape"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#panelClip)"><path id="highlight" fill="#2fe0d0" fill-opacity=".10" stroke="#2fe0d0" stroke-width="2"/><g id="opponent"></g><g id="player"></g></g></svg></div>
<div class="controls"><button id="following">Player P2</button><button id="leading">Player P1</button><button id="solo">Solo</button><button id="auto">Auto swap</button><label>Transition <input id="duration" type="range" min="200" max="900" step="10" value="450"><output id="durationOut">450 ms</output></label></div><p id="status" role="status">Player P2 — opponent above</p><p>Synthetic positions for review. Text and highlight use the same skew and curvature as the Lua timing panel. Solo fades out the opponent and centers the player. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.</p></main><script>
const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let mode='following',last=0,playing=false,nextAuto=0,autoIndex=0;
const states={following:{p:30.5,o:-49,a:1},leading:{p:-53.5,o:30.5,a:1},solo:{p:-11.5,o:-49,a:0}};
const motion={p:{x:30.5,v:0},o:{x:-49,v:0},a:{x:1,v:0}};
const player=document.getElementById('player'),opponent=document.getElementById('opponent');
function glyph(parent,font,size){const t=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');t.setAttribute('font-family',font);t.style.fontFamily=font;t.setAttribute('font-size',size);parent.append(t);return t}
const texts={pNumber:glyph(player,'Orbitron',23),pName:glyph(player,'Names',31),oNumber:glyph(opponent,'Orbitron',23),oName:glyph(opponent,'Names',29)};
// Same 1920x1080 canvas, common left-panel skew and halo projection as Lua.
function point(u,v){u-=(v+82)*10/172;const r=1650,a=u/r;return [960+(r-v)*Math.sin(a),535+r-(r-v)*Math.cos(a)]}
function strip(top,bottom){const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=32;i++)pts.push(point(-801+456*i/32,top));for(let i=32;i>=0;i--)pts.push(point(-801+456*i/32,bottom));return 'M'+pts.map(p=>p.join(',')).join(' L')+' Z'}
document.getElementById('clipShape').setAttribute('d',strip(-82,90));
function place(t,text,u,v,color){const p=point(u,v);const angle=(u-(v+82)*10/172)/1650*180/Math.PI;t.textContent=text;t.setAttribute('fill',color);t.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${p[0]} ${p[1]}) rotate(${angle})`)}
function setMode(next){mode=next;document.getElementById('status').textContent=mode==='leading'?'Player P1 — second place below':mode==='solo'?'Solo — player centered':'Player P2 — opponent above';if(reduced.matches)for(const k of ['p','o','a']){motion[k].x=states[mode][k];motion[k].v=0}}
function stop(){playing=false;document.getElementById('auto').textContent='Auto swap'}
for(const m of ['following','leading','solo'])document.getElementById(m).onclick=()=>{stop();setMode(m)};
document.getElementById('auto').onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;nextAuto=0;document.getElementById('auto').textContent=playing?'Pause auto swap':'Auto swap'};
document.getElementById('duration').oninput=e=>document.getElementById('durationOut').value=e.target.value+' ms';
function step(dt){const w=7/(Number(document.getElementById('duration').value)/1000);for(const k of ['p','o','a']){const s=motion[k],target=states[mode][k];if(reduced.matches){s.x=target;s.v=0;continue}const d=s.x-target,b=s.v+w*d,e=Math.exp(-w*dt);s.x=target+(d+b*dt)*e;s.v=(s.v-w*b*dt)*e;if(Math.abs(s.x-target)<.0001&&Math.abs(s.v)<.002){s.x=target;s.v=0}}}
function render(){const p=motion.p.x,o=motion.o.x;document.getElementById('highlight').setAttribute('d',strip(p-16.5,p+47.5));// Fade the opponent during the crossover so names never stack illegibly.
const clearance=Math.min(1,Math.abs(o-p)/55);opponent.setAttribute('opacity',Math.max(0,Math.min(1,motion.a.x))*clearance);
place(texts.pNumber,mode==='following'?'2':'1',-779,p+27,'#2fe0d0');place(texts.pName,'RUSSELL',-723,p+31,'#2fe0d0');
place(texts.oNumber,mode==='leading'?'2':'1',-779,o+27,'#9fb8c8');place(texts.oName,'BEARMAN',-723,o+29,'#ffffff');}
function tick(ms){const dt=last?Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,(ms-last)/1000)):0;last=ms;if(playing&&ms>=nextAuto){setMode(['following','leading','solo'][autoIndex++%3]);nextAuto=ms+1800}step(dt);render();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
render();requestAnimationFrame(tick);
</script></html>
