## source/build_assets.py

````python
"""Build every shipped PNG and glyph metadata. Python 3.10+, Pillow 11+.

All panel artwork is original layered vector geometry rasterized at 3x then
downsampled. Fonts are bundled under their SIL Open Font License. No game assets
or sponsor art are used. Run from any directory: python source/build_assets.py.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP = ROOT / 'apps/lua/HaloHUD'
OUT = APP / 'assets'
FONTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'fonts'
S = 3

def canvas(w, h):
    return Image.new('RGBA', (w*S, h*S))

def save(im, name):
    im.resize((im.width//S, im.height//S), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(OUT / name)

def panel(name, w, h, points):
    """Separate glass and white rim masks permit arbitrary runtime accent tint."""
    mask = Image.new('L', (w*S, h*S))
    p = [(int(x*S), int(y*S)) for x,y in points]
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).polygon(p, fill=255)
    glass = canvas(w,h)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(glass)
    for y in range(h*S):
        f = y/(h*S)
        d.line([(0,y),(w*S,y)], fill=(6+int(3*(1-f)),24+int(9*(1-f)),43+int(12*(1-f)),int(178-28*f)))
    glass.putalpha(Image.composite(glass.getchannel('A'), Image.new('L',glass.size),mask))
    # Faint original scan-line texture, deliberately subordinate to the digits.
    lines = canvas(w,h)
    ld = ImageDraw.Draw(lines)
    for x in range(12,w-12,4):
        ld.line([(x*S,10*S),(x*S,(h-10)*S)],fill=(118,202,218,12),width=1)
    lines.putalpha(Image.composite(lines.getchannel('A'), Image.new('L',lines.size),mask))
    glass = Image.alpha_composite(glass,lines)
    save(glass,name+'_fill.png')
    line = canvas(w,h)
    ImageDraw.Draw(line).line(p+[p[0]],fill=(255,255,255,200),width=2*S,joint='curve')
    glow=line.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(3*S))
    glow.putalpha(glow.getchannel('A').point(lambda x:int(x*0.45)))
    save(Image.alpha_composite(glow,line),name+'_rim.png')

def dial():
    fill=canvas(360,360)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(fill)
    d.ellipse((15*S,15*S,345*S,345*S),fill=(6,24,43,204))
    stripes=canvas(360,360); sd=ImageDraw.Draw(stripes)
    for x in range(30,331,4):
        sd.line((x*S,25*S,x*S,335*S),fill=(112,199,218,18),width=S)
    mask=Image.new('L',fill.size); ImageDraw.Draw(mask).ellipse((23*S,23*S,337*S,337*S),fill=255)
    stripes.putalpha(Image.composite(stripes.getchannel('A'),Image.new('L',fill.size),mask))
    save(Image.alpha_composite(fill,stripes),'dial_fill.png')
    rim=canvas(360,360); rd=ImageDraw.Draw(rim)
    rd.ellipse((15*S,15*S,345*S,345*S),outline=(255,255,255,230),width=2*S)
    rd.ellipse((21*S,21*S,339*S,339*S),outline=(255,255,255,95),width=S)
    rd.arc((11*S,11*S,349*S,349*S),190,350,fill=(255,255,255,95),width=3*S)
    glow=rim.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4*S))
    glow.putalpha(glow.getchannel('A').point(lambda x:int(x*.5)))
    save(Image.alpha_composite(glow,rim),'dial_rim.png')

def misc():
    # White alpha masks; all runtime colors are supplied by renderer.lua.
    tab=canvas(64,192); d=ImageDraw.Draw(tab)
    d.rounded_rectangle((5*S,5*S,59*S,187*S),radius=10*S,fill=(255,255,255,225),outline=(255,255,255,255),width=2*S)
    save(tab,'tab.png')
    fill=canvas(64,192)
    ImageDraw.Draw(fill).rounded_rectangle((7*S,7*S,57*S,185*S),radius=8*S,fill='white')
    save(fill,'tab_fill.png')
    glow=canvas(256,64); d=ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    d.rounded_rectangle((9*S,12*S,247*S,52*S),radius=4*S,fill=(255,255,255,90))
    save(glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(6*S)),'boost_glow.png')
    battery=canvas(128,48); d=ImageDraw.Draw(battery)
    d.rounded_rectangle((5*S,4*S,118*S,44*S),radius=5*S,fill='white')
    d.rectangle((118*S,17*S,123*S,31*S),fill='white')
    save(battery,'battery.png')
    bolt=canvas(32,48); ImageDraw.Draw(bolt).polygon([(19*S,2*S),(5*S,27*S),(15*S,27*S),(11*S,46*S),(28*S,19*S),(18*S,19*S)],fill='white')
    save(bolt,'bolt.png')
    Image.new('RGBA',(2,2),'white').save(OUT/'white.png')

def atlas(name, filename, bold=False):
    font=ImageFont.truetype(str(FONTS/filename),72)
    if bold:
        # Orbitron variable weight; Pillow's variation API is only needed at build time.
        font.set_variation_by_axes([700])
    im=Image.new('RGBA',(2048,1024)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    cap=-font.getbbox('H',anchor='ls')[1]
    digits=max(font.getlength(c) for c in '0123456789')
    data={'texture':f'assets/{name}.png','cap':cap,'glyphs':{}}
    for i,code in enumerate(range(32,127)):
        c=chr(code); x=(i%16)*128+8; baseline=(i//16)*128+96
        box=font.getbbox(c,anchor='ls')
        d.text((x,baseline),c,font=font,fill='white',anchor='ls')
        adv=digits if c.isdigit() else font.getlength(c)
        # bbox metadata in font pixels, UV padded by one pixel for filtering.
        x0,y0,x1,y1=box
        data['glyphs'][str(code)]={'advance':round(adv,4),'x':((adv-(x1-x0))/2-1 if c.isdigit() else x0-1),'y':y0-1,
          'w':x1-x0+2,'h':y1-y0+2,
          'uv':[(x+x0-1)/2048,(baseline+y0-1)/1024,(x+x1+1)/2048,(baseline+y1+1)/1024]}
    im.save(OUT/f'{name}.png')
    return data

def lua(v):
    if isinstance(v,dict): return '{'+','.join('['+json.dumps(str(k))+']='+lua(x) for k,x in v.items())+'}'
    if isinstance(v,list): return '{'+','.join(lua(x) for x in v)+'}'
    return json.dumps(v,separators=(',',':'))

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    # The renderer applies the shared -10/172 skew to this canonical rectangle.
    panel('left',512,192,[(17,10),(497,10),(497,182),(17,182)])
    inset=12*(1+(10/172)**2)**0.5
    for name,top,bottom in [('player_highlight',106,170),('player_highlight_solo',64,128),('player_highlight_leader',22,86)]:
        highlight=canvas(512,192); hd=ImageDraw.Draw(highlight)
        box=((17+inset)*S,top*S,(497-inset)*S,bottom*S)
        hd.rectangle(box,fill=(255,255,255,25),outline=(255,255,255,240),width=2*S)
        save(highlight,name+'.png')
    panel('right',512,192,[(15,10),(495,10),(505,182),(25,182)])
    panel('module',96,192,[(10,7),(86,7),(86,185),(10,185)])
    dial(); misc()
    from curved_assets import build
    build(OUT,S)
    data={'labels':atlas('labels','Orbitron.ttf',True),
          'names':atlas('names','BarlowCondensed-BoldItalic.ttf')}
    (APP/'glyphs.lua').write_text('-- Generated by source/build_assets.py. Do not edit.\nreturn '+lua(data)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    (ROOT/'source/glyphs.json').write_text(json.dumps(data),encoding='utf-8')
    icon=Image.new('RGBA',(64,64)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(icon)
    d.ellipse((5,5,59,59),fill=(6,24,43,230),outline=(47,224,208),width=3)
    d.arc((13,16,51,51),190,350,fill=(58,184,232),width=5)
    icon.save(APP/'icon.png')
    manifest=[]
    for p in sorted(OUT.glob('*.png'))+[APP/'icon.png']:
        with Image.open(p) as a: manifest.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(APP)).replace('\\','/'),'width':a.width,'height':a.height})
    (ROOT/'source/asset-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Built {len(manifest)} PNG assets and glyphs.lua')

if __name__=='__main__': main()

````

## source/build_package.py

````python
"""Regenerate complete text listing, hashes and both distribution ZIPs.

Run after rebuilding assets, testing, and rendering previews:
    python source/build_package.py
No network, game directory access or destructive operations.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, zipfile, json

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP=ROOT/'apps/lua/HaloHUD'

EXCLUDED_DIRS={'.git','.venv','venv','__pycache__','.pytest_cache','.mypy_cache',
               '.vscode','.idea','htmlcov','dist','.release-tools'}
def publishable(p):
    rel=p.relative_to(ROOT)
    return not any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in rel.parts) and not (
        p.name in {'.env','.coverage','.DS_Store','Thumbs.db','Desktop.ini'}
        or (p.name.startswith('.env.') and p.name!='.env.example')
        or p.suffix.lower() in {'.pyc','.pyo','.log','.pem','.key','.zip'})

def files():
    return sorted(p for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and publishable(p)
                  and p.name not in ('FILES.sha256','SOURCE-CONTENTS.md'))

def main():
    # Preserve license notices when installing only the runtime ZIP.
    licenses=APP/'licenses'; licenses.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    license_source=ROOT/'LICENSE' if (ROOT/'LICENSE').exists() else ROOT/'LICENSE.txt'
    for src in [license_source,*sorted((ROOT/'source/fonts').glob('*OFL.txt'))]:
        target='LICENSE.txt' if src==license_source else src.name
        (licenses/target).write_bytes(src.read_bytes())
    source=[]
    extensions={'.lua': 'lua','.ini':'ini','.example':'ini','.py':'python',
                '.txt':'text','.json':'json','.html':'html','.cjs':'javascript'}
    for p in files():
        if p.suffix not in extensions: continue
        text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        source.append('## '+p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()+'\n\n````'+extensions[p.suffix]+'\n'+text+'\n````\n')
    (ROOT/'docs/SOURCE-CONTENTS.md').write_text('# Complete text file contents\n\n'
        'Runtime, generator, test, camera, license and offline-demo files are reproduced below. '
        'PNG/font binaries are supplied as actual files; regenerate PNGs with source/build_assets.py.\n\n'
        +'\n'.join(source),encoding='utf-8')
    allfiles=files()+[ROOT/'docs/SOURCE-CONTENTS.md']
    (ROOT/'FILES.sha256').write_text(''.join(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+
        p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()+'\n' for p in allfiles),encoding='utf-8')
    output=ROOT/'dist'; output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    complete=output/'HaloHUD-complete.zip'
    install=output/'HaloHUD-install.zip'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(complete,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as z:
        for p in sorted(allfiles+[ROOT/'FILES.sha256']): z.write(p,ROOT.name+'/'+p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(install,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as z:
        for p in sorted(APP.rglob('*')):
            if p.is_file() and publishable(p): z.write(p,p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    for path in (install,complete):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
            assert z.testzip() is None
            assert not any('__pycache__' in n for n in z.namelist())
            print(f'{path.name}: {len(z.namelist())} files, {path.stat().st_size:,} bytes, CRC passed')
    # Check manifest assets are present in the install, at exact dimensions.
    from PIL import Image
    with zipfile.ZipFile(install) as z:
        names=set(z.namelist())
        for entry in json.loads((ROOT/'source/asset-manifest.json').read_text()):
            asset=APP/entry['file']
            assert asset.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() in names
            with Image.open(asset) as im: assert im.size==(entry['width'],entry['height'])
    print('Install structure and all '+str(len(json.loads((ROOT/'source/asset-manifest.json').read_text())))+' asset sizes verified')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

````

## source/curved_assets.py

````python
"""Original approved curved gauge masks; called by build_assets.py."""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math

def build(out, factor=3):
    S=factor
    def new(): return Image.new('RGBA',(640*S,320*S))
    def points(values,side): return [((320+side*x)*S,(160+y)*S) for x,y in values]
    def curve(y,r=241): return math.sqrt(r*r-y*y)
    fill,rim,bars,energy,energy_rim=[new() for _ in range(5)]
    for side in (-1,1):
        p=[(curve(-114+228*i/72)+54,-114+228*i/72) for i in range(73)]
        p += [(curve(114-228*i/72),114-228*i/72) for i in range(73)]
        # Round only the four corners, preserving the fitted curved side walls.
        rounded=[]
        for i,v in enumerate(p):
            before,after=p[(i-1)%len(p)],p[(i+1)%len(p)]
            def near(w):
                d=math.hypot(w[0]-v[0],w[1]-v[1]); f=min(3/d,.45)
                return (v[0]+(w[0]-v[0])*f,v[1]+(w[1]-v[1])*f)
            a,b=near(before),near(after)
            for j in range(5):
                t=j/4;rounded.append(((1-t)**2*a[0]+2*(1-t)*t*v[0]+t*t*b[0],(1-t)**2*a[1]+2*(1-t)*t*v[1]+t*t*b[1]))
        rp=points(rounded,side)
        ImageDraw.Draw(fill).polygon(rp,fill='white')
        ImageDraw.Draw(rim).line(rp+[rp[0]],fill='white',width=round(1.5*S),joint='curve')
        for i in range(16):
            bottom=110-i*220/16; top=bottom-220/16+2
            band=[(curve(top+(bottom-top)*j/8,243)+50,top+(bottom-top)*j/8) for j in range(9)]
            band += [(curve(bottom+(top-bottom)*j/8,243),bottom+(top-bottom)*j/8) for j in range(9)]
            ImageDraw.Draw(bars).polygon(points(band,side),fill='white')
        for im,width in ((energy,46),(energy_rim,50)):
            d=ImageDraw.Draw(im); path=[(206*math.cos(math.radians(-27+54*i/96)),206*math.sin(math.radians(-27+54*i/96))) for i in range(97)]
            pts=points(path,side)
            outline=[((206+width/2)*math.cos(math.radians(-27+54*i/96)),(206+width/2)*math.sin(math.radians(-27+54*i/96))) for i in range(97)]
            outline += [((206-width/2)*math.cos(math.radians(-27+54*i/96)),(206-width/2)*math.sin(math.radians(-27+54*i/96))) for i in range(96,-1,-1)]
            d.polygon(points(outline,side),fill='white')
            for x,y in (pts[0],pts[-1]): d.ellipse((x-width*S/2,y-width*S/2,x+width*S/2,y+width*S/2),fill='white')
    for name,im in zip(('curved_pedal_fill','curved_pedal_rim','curved_pedal_segments','curved_energy_fill','curved_energy_rim'),(fill,rim,bars,energy,energy_rim)):
        im.resize((640,320),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(out/(name+'.png'))

````

## source/extract_release_notes.py

````python
"""Extract one version's README changelog for a GitHub release."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import re

def extract(readme, version):
    version=version.removeprefix('v')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?',version):
        raise ValueError('Expected a semantic version such as v1.10.0')
    active=False; capture=False; sections=[]; body=[]; fence=None
    for line in readme.splitlines():
        stripped=line.lstrip()
        marker=re.match(r'^(`{3,}|~{3,})',stripped)
        if marker:
            token=marker.group(1)
            if fence is None: fence=token
            elif token[0]==fence[0] and len(token)>=len(fence): fence=None
            if capture: body.append(line)
            continue
        if fence is None:
            heading=re.match(r'^(#{1,3})[ \t]+(.+?)\s*$',line)
            if heading:
                level=len(heading.group(1)); title=heading.group(2)
                if capture:
                    sections.append('\n'.join(body).strip());body=[];capture=False
                if level<=2:
                    active=level==2 and title.casefold()=='changelog'
                elif active and re.match(r'^v?'+re.escape(version)+r'(?=\s|$)',title):
                    capture=True
                continue
        if capture: body.append(line)
    if capture: sections.append('\n'.join(body).strip())
    if len(sections)!=1 or not sections[0]:
        raise ValueError(f'Expected one nonempty changelog entry for {version}; found {len(sections)}')
    return sections[0]+'\n'

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('tag');parser.add_argument('--readme',type=Path,default=Path('README.md'))
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    notes=extract(args.readme.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),args.tag)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(notes,encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Extracted {args.tag} changelog into {args.output}')

if __name__=='__main__': main()

````

## source/inspect_kn5.py

````python
"""Read-only mesh-bound inspection. Does not open or unpack data.acd.

Binary layout checked against Content Manager's open-source Kn5Basic.Kn5Reader:
https://github.com/gro-ove/actools/blob/master/AcTools/Kn5File/Kn5Basic.cs
and ReadAheadBinaryReader.cs. No textures or geometry are exported.
Usage: python source/inspect_kn5.py path/to/fu26.kn5
"""
from pathlib import Path
import struct,json,sys
import numpy as np

def inspect(path):
    path=Path(path)
    if path.suffix.lower()!='.kn5': raise ValueError('Only a .kn5 model may be inspected')
    nodes=[]
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        def read(n):
            b=f.read(n)
            if len(b)!=n: raise ValueError('Truncated model')
            return b
        def u():return struct.unpack('<I',read(4))[0]
        def skip(n):f.seek(n,1)
        def string():
            n=u()
            if n>100000:raise ValueError('Unexpected string length')
            return read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        assert read(6)==b'sc6969','Unsupported/encrypted model: no decryption attempted'
        version=u()
        if version>5:u()
        textures=u()
        for _ in range(textures):u();string();skip(u())
        materials=u()
        for _ in range(materials):
            string();string();skip(6)
            for _ in range(u()):string();skip(40)
            for _ in range(u()):string();u();string()
        def node(parent,path):
            kind=u(); name=string(); children=u();active=bool(read(1)[0])
            here=path+'/'+name; world=parent
            item={'path':here,'class':kind,'active':active}
            if kind==1:
                local=np.frombuffer(read(64),dtype='<f4').reshape((4,4)).astype(float)
                world=local@parent
                item['world_translation']=world[3,:3].tolist()
            elif kind in (2,3):
                skip(3)
                if kind==3:
                    for _ in range(u()):string();skip(64)
                count=u();stride=44 if kind==2 else 76
                raw=read(count*stride)
                vertices=np.ndarray((count,3),dtype='<f4',buffer=raw,strides=(stride,4)).astype(float)
                points=np.c_[vertices,np.ones(count)]@world
                item['vertices']=count
                item['world_min']=points[:,:3].min(axis=0).tolist()
                item['world_max']=points[:,:3].max(axis=0).tolist()
                skip(2*u());skip(33 if kind==2 else 16)
            else:raise ValueError('Unsupported node class '+str(kind))
            nodes.append(item)
            for _ in range(children):node(world,here)
        node(np.eye(4),'')
        consumed=f.tell()
        trailing=path.stat().st_size-consumed
    selected=[n for n in nodes if any(t in n['path'].lower() for t in ('halo','lcd','steer','driver','head','camera','cockpit'))]
    return {'model':path.name,'version':version,'node_count':len(nodes),
            'bytes_consumed':consumed,'trailing_bytes':trailing,
            'note':'Trailing bytes are not interpreted; bounds are from parsed nodes only.',
            'selected_nodes':selected}

if __name__=='__main__':
    data=inspect(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'reports/model-inspection.json'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(data,indent=2))

````

## source/render_aero_motion.py

````python
"""Render three stages of the integrated Lua aero geometry for visual QA."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,math
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tests'))
from headless import Harness,ROOT
from render_preview import draw_commands
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont

def main():
    strip=Image.new('RGB',(900,390),(30,48,60));d=ImageDraw.Draw(strip)
    for i,phase in enumerate((0,0.5,1)):
        h=Harness();h.lua.globals().phaseFixture=phase
        h.lua.execute('''local R=require('renderer');local S=require('settings');local T=require('telemetry')
          probe=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080)
          local t=T.new();T.demo(t,0,'FULL');t.aeroPhase=phaseFixture
          ui.beginTransparentWindow('motion',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
          probe.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
        ''')
        point=h.lua.globals().probe.point
        corners=[point(u,v,False,'right') for u in (330,418) for v in (-76,42)]
        box=(math.floor(min(p.x for p in corners))-8,math.floor(min(p.y for p in corners))-8,
             math.ceil(max(p.x for p in corners))+8,math.ceil(max(p.y for p in corners))+8)
        im=draw_commands(h.commands);bg=Image.new('RGBA',im.size,(36,51,62,255));bg.alpha_composite(im)
        crop=bg.crop(box).convert('RGB');crop.thumbnail((280,320))
        strip.paste(crop,(i*300+(300-crop.width)//2,45))
        d.text((i*300+20,15),('Inactive','Transition','Active')[i],font=ImageFont.load_default(size=18),fill='white')
    strip.save(ROOT/'previews/Aero-Lua-motion.png')
    print('Integrated Lua aero motion contact sheet rendered')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

````

## source/render_leaderboard_motion.py

````python
"""Render the real Lua leaderboard motion at selected transition points."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tests'))
from headless import Harness,ROOT
from render_preview import draw_commands
from PIL import Image
h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
  local S=require('settings');local T=require('telemetry');local R=require('renderer');local M=require('leaderboard_motion')
  r=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080);t=T.new();T.demo(t,0,'FULL');t.solo=false;t.leaderFirst=false
  m=M.new();t.leaderboardMotion=M.update(m,t,0,450)
  function capture(dt,leading,solo)
    t.leaderFirst=leading;t.solo=solo;t.leaderboardMotion=M.update(m,t,dt,450)
    ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false);r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
  end
""")
frames=[]
for count,leading,solo in [(0,False,False),(4,True,False),(90,True,False),(90,False,True)]:
    for _ in range(count):
        h.commands=[];h.lua.globals().capture(1/60,leading,solo)
    h.commands=[];h.lua.globals().capture(0,leading,solo)
    frame=Image.new('RGBA',(1920,1080),(36,51,62,255));frame.alpha_composite(draw_commands(h.commands))
    frames.append(frame.crop((50,400,900,850)).resize((680,360)))
strip=Image.new('RGB',(680*4,360))
for i,im in enumerate(frames):strip.paste(im,(i*680,0))
strip.save(ROOT/'previews/Leaderboard-Lua-motion.png')
print('Rendered Lua leaderboard: following, transition, leading, solo.')

````

## source/render_preview.py

````python
"""Offline renderer and self-contained animated demo from actual Lua draw calls.

Run python source/render_preview.py, optionally --html. Pillow perspective
resampling differs slightly from CSP's two-triangle texture mapping.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import sys, math, json, base64, argparse
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tests'))
from headless import Harness, ROOT, APP
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw
import numpy as np

def draw_commands(commands,width=1920,height=1080):
    out=Image.new('RGBA',(width,height)); textures={}; tinted={}
    for texture,points,color,uv in commands:
        if texture not in textures: textures[texture]=Image.open(APP/texture).convert('RGBA')
        k=(texture,tuple(round(c,5) for c in color))
        if k not in tinted:
            tex=textures[texture]
            factors=[max(0,min(255,round(c*255))) for c in color]
            tinted[k]=ImageChops.multiply(tex,Image.new('RGBA',tex.size,tuple(factors)))
        tex=tinted[k]
        x0=math.floor(min(p[0] for p in points)); y0=math.floor(min(p[1] for p in points))
        x1=math.ceil(max(p[0] for p in points)); y1=math.ceil(max(p[1] for p in points))
        if x1<=x0 or y1<=y0: continue
        # Inverse projective map from local destination pixels into source UVs.
        A=[]; B=[]
        for p,t in zip(points,uv):
            x,y=p[0]-x0,p[1]-y0; u,v=t[0]*tex.width,t[1]*tex.height
            A.append([x,y,1,0,0,0,-u*x,-u*y]); B.append(u)
            A.append([0,0,0,x,y,1,-v*x,-v*y]); B.append(v)
        try: coeff=np.linalg.solve(np.asarray(A),np.asarray(B))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError: continue
        patch=tex.transform((x1-x0,y1-y0),Image.Transform.PERSPECTIVE,coeff,
                            Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
        # Projective mapping alone samples outside the destination quad. Clip it.
        mask=Image.new('L',patch.size)
        ImageDraw.Draw(mask).polygon([(p[0]-x0,p[1]-y0) for p in points],fill=255)
        patch.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(patch.getchannel('A'),mask))
        out.alpha_composite(patch,(x0,y0))
    return out

def write_html():
    h=Harness(demo='ON'); frames=[]
    # Cache stable shapes in a command pool. This records the app itself; the web
    # demo contains no independently implemented telemetry or layout equations.
    pool=[]; index={}
    for i in range(192):
        # Step at graphics-like dt so animation timing matches the game, then
        # record only 12 snapshots/sec for the lightweight browser demo.
        for _ in range(5): commands=h.frame(1/60)
        frame=[]
        for c in commands:
            # Round only in the browser export, never the CSP app.
            c=[c[0],[[round(v,2) for v in p] for p in c[1]],
               [round(v,4) for v in c[2]],[[round(v,6) for v in p] for p in c[3]]]
            key=json.dumps(c,separators=(',',':'))
            if key not in index: index[key]=len(pool); pool.append(c)
            frame.append(index[key])
        frames.append(frame)
    images={p.relative_to(APP).as_posix():'data:image/png;base64,'+base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode()
            for p in (APP/'assets').glob('*.png')}
    data=json.dumps({'pool':pool,'frames':frames,'images':images},separators=(',',':'))
    html='''<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">
<title>HaloHUD for Assetto Corsa — offline demo</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#101b23;color:#eaf6fa;font:15px system-ui,sans-serif}
main{max-width:1920px;margin:auto}canvas{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;background:#24333e}
footer{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:16px 24px}
button{font:inherit;color:#fff;background:#164e67;border:1px solid #2fe0d0;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}
p{max-width:900px;margin:0;color:#aec3d0}input{accent-color:#2fe0d0}a{color:#2fe0d0}
</style><main><canvas id="hud" width="1920" height="1080" aria-label="Animated synthetic HaloHUD telemetry. No game connection."></canvas>
<footer><button id="play">Pause demo</button><label>Time <input id="seek" type="range" min="0" max="191" value="0"></label>
<label>Background <input id="bg" type="color" value="#24333e"></label>
<p>Synthetic telemetry · 16-second loop. Rendered from the packaged Lua app's draw commands at 12 snapshots/sec. The live app updates every game frame. This preview does not test CSP integration or performance.</p></footer></main>
<script>const DATA=__DATA__;
const cv=document.getElementById('hud'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const seek=document.getElementById('seek'),play=document.getElementById('play');
const bg=document.getElementById('bg');let playing=true,frame=0,last=0;
const textures={},cache=new Map();
function tinted(name,c){
 const key=name+'|'+c.join(',');if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
 const im=textures[name],can=document.createElement('canvas');can.width=im.width;can.height=im.height;
 const x=can.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(im,0,0);const d=x.getImageData(0,0,can.width,can.height);
 for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]*=c[0];d.data[i+1]*=c[1];d.data[i+2]*=c[2];d.data[i+3]*=c[3];}
 x.putImageData(d,0,0);cache.set(key,can);return can;
}
function tri(im,p,t,ids){
 const [a,b,c]=ids.map(i=>p[i]),[u,v,w]=ids.map(i=>[t[i][0]*im.width,t[i][1]*im.height]);
 const det=u[0]*(v[1]-w[1])+v[0]*(w[1]-u[1])+w[0]*(u[1]-v[1]);if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)return;
 function coeff(j){return [
 (a[j]*(v[1]-w[1])+b[j]*(w[1]-u[1])+c[j]*(u[1]-v[1]))/det,
 (a[j]*(w[0]-v[0])+b[j]*(u[0]-w[0])+c[j]*(v[0]-u[0]))/det,
 (a[j]*(v[0]*w[1]-w[0]*v[1])+b[j]*(w[0]*u[1]-u[0]*w[1])+c[j]*(u[0]*v[1]-v[0]*u[1]))/det];}
 const X=coeff(0),Y=coeff(1);ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a);ctx.lineTo(...b);ctx.lineTo(...c);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();
 ctx.transform(X[0],Y[0],X[1],Y[1],X[2],Y[2]);ctx.drawImage(im,0,0);ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,1920,1080);ctx.fillStyle=bg.value;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1920,1080);
 for(const id of DATA.frames[frame]){const [name,p,c,t]=DATA.pool[id],im=tinted(name,c);tri(im,p,t,[0,1,2]);tri(im,p,t,[0,2,3]);}seek.value=frame;}
play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;play.textContent=playing?'Pause demo':'Play demo'};
seek.oninput=()=>{frame=+seek.value;draw()};bg.oninput=draw;
Promise.all(Object.entries(DATA.images).map(([name,url])=>new Promise(resolve=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{textures[name]=im;resolve()};im.src=url}))).then(()=>{
 draw();requestAnimationFrame(function tick(t){if(playing&&t-last>=1000/12){frame=(frame+1)%DATA.frames.length;draw();last=t}requestAnimationFrame(tick)});
});</script>'''.replace('__DATA__',data)
    (ROOT/'previews/Demo.html').write_text(html,encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Demo.html: {len(pool)} pooled commands, {len(frames)} frames')

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--html',action='store_true');args=p.parse_args()
    commands=Harness().snapshot()
    im=draw_commands(commands)
    im.save(ROOT/'previews/HaloHUD-transparent.png')
    back=Image.new('RGBA',im.size,(36,51,62,255)); back.alpha_composite(im)
    back.convert('RGB').save(ROOT/'previews/HaloHUD-preview.png')
    # Useful close-up without changing the runtime's proportions.
    back.crop((65,340,1870,940)).convert('RGB').save(ROOT/'previews/HaloHUD-detail.png')
    if args.html: write_html()
    print(f'Preview captured from {len(commands)} actual Lua textured quads')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

````

````python
"""Render and measure the actual projected timing panel bottom inset."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,math
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tests'))
from headless import Harness,ROOT
from render_preview import draw_commands
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw

def main():
    reports=[]
    for curve in (0,1,1.6):
        h=Harness(overrides={'CURVE':curve})
        h.lua.execute('''local S=require('settings');local R=require('renderer')
          local cfg=S.read(ac.INIConfig.load('config.ini'))
          layoutProbe=R.new(cfg,1920,1080)''')
        point=h.lua.globals().layoutProbe.point
        pairs=[];gaps=[]
        # Same longitudinal parameter, highlight bottom y=170 versus frame y=182.
        for i in range(17):
            u=-830+42+430*i/16
            a=point(u,78,False,'left');b=point(u,90,False,'left')
            p,q=(a.x,a.y),(b.x,b.y)
            gaps.append(math.dist(p,q));pairs.append((p,q))
        reports.append({'curve':curve,'design_normal_inset':12,
                        'projected_bottom_min':min(gaps),'projected_bottom_max':max(gaps),
                        'variation':max(gaps)-min(gaps)})
        if curve==1:
            commands=h.snapshot();im=draw_commands(commands)
            bg=Image.new('RGBA',im.size,(36,51,62,255));bg.alpha_composite(im)
            d=ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
            for p,q in pairs: d.line([p,q],fill=(255,220,80),width=2)
            panel=[c for c in commands if c[0]=='assets/left_rim.png']
            pts=[p for c in panel for p in c[1]]
            box=(int(min(p[0] for p in pts))-10,int(min(p[1] for p in pts))-10,
                 int(max(p[0] for p in pts))+10,int(max(p[1] for p in pts))+20)
            crop=bg.crop(box).resize(((box[2]-box[0])*2,(box[3]-box[1])*2))
            crop.save(ROOT/'previews/Highlight-inset-verification.png')
        assert max(gaps)-min(gaps)<0.01
    (ROOT/'reports/highlight-inset-measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

````

````python
"""CSP interface mock for Lua 5.1 execution and offline pixel previews.

This tests app logic and records the *actual* Lua draw calls. It does not emulate
the game engine, CSP FFI, texture batching, filtering or GPU timing.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import configparser
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP = ROOT / 'apps/lua/HaloHUD'
# Development environment can keep dependencies outside the deliverable.
DEV_DEPS = ROOT.parents[1] / 'work/python-deps'
if DEV_DEPS.exists(): sys.path.insert(0,str(DEV_DEPS))
from lupa.lua51 import LuaRuntime

class Harness:
    def __init__(self, width=1920, height=1080, demo='ON', overrides=None):
        self.lua=LuaRuntime(unpack_returned_tuples=True)
        self.commands=[]
        self.saves=0
        self.ini=configparser.ConfigParser(inline_comment_prefixes=(';',))
        self.ini.read(APP/'config.ini',encoding='utf-8')
        self.ini['HUD']['DEMO']=demo
        for k,v in (overrides or {}).items(): self.ini['HUD'][k]=str(v)
        self.width,self.height=width,height
        g=self.lua.globals()
        g['__dirname']=APP.as_posix()
        g.py_ini_get=self.ini_get
        g.py_ini_set=self.ini_set
        g.py_ini_save=self.ini_save
        g.py_record=self.record
        g.py_clock=time.perf_counter
        g.py_width=width; g.py_height=height
        self.lua.execute("package.path = "+repr(APP.as_posix()+'/?.lua;')+" .. package.path")
        self.lua.execute('''
          script={}
          function vec2(x,y) return {x=x or 0,y=y or 0} end
          function rgbm(r,g,b,a) return {r=r,g=g,b=b,mult=a or 1} end
          local inWindow=false
          ui={
            beginTransparentWindow=function(id,pos,size,padding,inputs)
              assert(not inWindow, 'Unbalanced window')
              assert(inputs==false or (inputs==true and id=='HaloHUD:dragHandle'))
              inWindow=true
            end,
            endTransparentWindow=function() assert(inWindow); inWindow=false end,
            drawImageQuad=function(...) assert(inWindow); py_record(...) end,
            text=function() end, textWrapped=function() end,
            invisibleButton=function() end, itemActive=function() return false end,
            mouseDelta=function() return vec2() end, captureMouse=function() end,
            drawRectFilled=function() end, setCursor=function() end,
            checkbox=function() return false end, button=function() return false end,
            slider=function(_,v) return v end
          }
          os.preciseClock=py_clock
          ac={
            SessionType={Race=3},
            onRelease=function(callback) releaseCallback=callback end,
            INIConfig={load=function() return {
              get=function(_,s,k,d) return py_ini_get(s,k,d) end,
              set=function(_,s,k,v) py_ini_set(s,k,v) end,
              save=function(_,path) py_ini_save(path) end} end},
            getSim=function() return {carsCount=0,currentSessionIndex=0} end,
            getUI=function() return {windowSize=vec2(py_width,py_height)} end,
            getCar=function() return nil end,
            getCarID=function() return 'generic_test_car' end,
            getSession=function() return nil end
          }
        ''')
        self.lua.execute((APP/'HaloHUD.lua').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

    def ini_get(self,s,k,d):
        raw=self.ini.get(s,k,fallback=str(d))
        if isinstance(d,bool): return raw.strip().upper() in ('1','TRUE','YES','ON')
        if isinstance(d,(int,float)): return float(raw)
        return raw

    def ini_set(self,s,k,v):
        if not self.ini.has_section(s): self.ini.add_section(s)
        self.ini[s][k]=('1' if v else '0') if isinstance(v,bool) else str(v)

    def ini_save(self,path):
        self.saves+=1  # deliberately never writes the real config in a test

    def record(self,texture,p1,p2,p3,p4,color,u1,u2,u3,u4):
        points=[[round(p.x,5),round(p.y,5)] for p in (p1,p2,p3,p4)]
        uv=[[float(p.x),float(p.y)] for p in (u1,u2,u3,u4)]
        tint=[float(color.r),float(color.g),float(color.b),float(color.mult)]
        self.commands.append([texture,points,tint,uv])

    def frame(self,dt=1/60):
        self.commands=[]
        self.lua.globals().script.update(dt)
        self.lua.globals().script.drawHUD()
        return self.commands

    def snapshot(self):
        """Reference-number fixture using the real renderer, not a separate mockup."""
        self.frame(0)
        self.commands=[]
        self.lua.execute('''
          local T=require('telemetry'); local R=require('renderer')
          local t=T.new(); T.demo(t,0,'FULL')
          t.speed=296; t.rpm=13250; t.gear=7; t.brake=0.08; t.throttle=0.94
          t.charge=0.72; t.overtake=true; t.charging=true; t.ersInput=0.88
          t.deploy=0.88; t.recharge=0.64
          local cfg=require('settings').read(ac.INIConfig.load(__dirname..'/config.ini'))
          local r=R.new(cfg,py_width,py_height)
          ui.beginTransparentWindow('preview',vec2(),vec2(py_width,py_height),true,false)
          r.render(t); ui.endTransparentWindow()
        ''')
        return self.commands

````

## tests/test_aero_animation.py

````python
import json,shutil,subprocess,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from headless import Harness

class AeroAnimationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('node'),'Node required only for HTML/Lua parity test')
    def test_matches_approved_html_javascript(self):
        frames=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['node',str(Path(__file__).with_name('aero_reference.cjs'))],text=True))
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("A=require('aero');motion=A.new()")
        g=h.lua.globals()
        for f in frames:
            g.A.update(g.motion,f['active'],f['dt'],420)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(g.motion.phase,f['phase'],places=10)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(g.motion.velocity,f['velocity'],places=10)

    def test_parallel_separation_and_projected_quads(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local A=require('aero');local S=require('settings');local R=require('renderer')
          local function separated(a,b)
            for _,polygon in ipairs({a,b}) do
              for i=1,4 do
                local j=i%4+1;local nx=-(polygon[j].y-polygon[i].y);local ny=polygon[j].x-polygon[i].x
                local amin,amax,bmin,bmax=math.huge,-math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge
                for k=1,4 do
                  local x=a[k].x*nx+a[k].y*ny;amin=math.min(amin,x);amax=math.max(amax,x)
                  x=b[k].x*nx+b[k].y*ny;bmin=math.min(bmin,x);bmax=math.max(bmax,x)
                end
                if amax<bmin or bmax<amin then return true end
              end
            end
            return false
          end
          for _,curve in ipairs({0,1,1.6}) do for _,scale in ipairs({0.5,1.5}) do
            local cfg=S.read(nil);cfg.curve=curve;cfg.rightScale=scale
            local r=R.new(cfg,1920,1080)
            for i=0,100 do
              local poses=A.poses(i/100);assert(poses[1].angle==poses[2].angle)
              local quads={}
              for j=1,2 do
                local vertices=A.vertices(poses[j],373.5,0);quads[j]={}
                for k=1,4 do quads[j][k]=r.point(vertices[k][1],vertices[k][2],false,'right') end
              end
              assert(separated(quads[1],quads[2]),'Aero quads must never cross')
            end
          end end
        ''')

    def test_reversal_continuity_and_frame_rate(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local A=require('aero');local a=A.new();local b=A.new()
          for i=1,12 do A.update(a,true,1/60,420) end
          for i=1,24 do A.update(b,true,1/120,420) end
          assert(math.abs(a.phase-b.phase)<1e-12)
          local p,v=a.phase,a.velocity
          A.update(a,false,0,420);assert(math.abs(a.phase-p)<1e-12 and math.abs(a.velocity-v)<1e-12)
          for i=1,120 do A.update(a,false,1/60,420) end
          assert(a.phase==0 and a.velocity==0)
        ''')

    def test_app_state_survives_layout_rebuild(self):
        h=Harness(demo='AUTO');phases=[]
        h.lua.globals().recordPhase=phases.append
        h.lua.execute('''local R=require('renderer');local create=R.new
          R.new=function(...)
            local r=create(...);local render=r.render
            r.render=function(t) recordPhase(t.aeroPhase);render(t) end
            return r
          end
          local c={index=0,drsPresent=true,drsActive=true,driverName=function() return 'Player' end}
          ac.getCar=function() return c end
````

````python
import unittest
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
from headless import Harness,APP,ROOT

class ApprovedReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_race_leader_second_follower_and_solo_transitions(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local T=require('telemetry');local R=require('renderer');local S=require('settings')
          local t=T.new();local r=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080)
          local p={index=0,racePosition=1,driverName=function() return 'George Russell' end}
          local b={index=1,racePosition=2,driverName=function() return 'Oliver Bearman' end}
          local cars={[0]=p,b};local get=function(i) return cars[i] end
          local texts,mask;local text,draw=r.text,r.draw
          r.text=function(label,u,v,...) texts[tostring(label)]=v;text(label,u,v,...) end
          r.draw=function(q,...)
            if q[1]:find('player_highlight',1,true) then mask=q[1] end
            draw(q,...)
          end
          local function render()
            texts={};ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
            r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
            assert(not texts['CLEAR TRACK'])
          end
          T.raceRows(t,p,2,get,'FULL');render()
          assert(t.leaderFirst and t.ahead.position=='2' and t.ahead.name=='BEARMAN')
          assert(texts.RUSSELL==-53.5 and texts.BEARMAN==30.5)
          assert(mask=='assets/player_highlight_leader.png')
          p.racePosition=2;b.racePosition=1
          T.raceRows(t,p,2,get,'FULL');render()
          assert(not t.leaderFirst and texts.RUSSELL==30.5 and texts.BEARMAN==-49)
          assert(mask=='assets/player_highlight.png')
          p.racePosition=1;T.raceRows(t,p,1,get,'FULL');render()
          assert(t.solo and not t.leaderFirst and texts.RUSSELL==-11.5 and not texts.BEARMAN)
          assert(mask=='assets/player_highlight_solo.png')
          T.raceRows(t,p,2,function() return nil end,'FULL');render()
          assert(t.leaderFirst and texts.UNAVAILABLE and not texts['CLEAR TRACK'])
        ''')

    def test_assets_match_approved_html_preview(self):
        for actual,approved in [('battery.png','battery_fill.png'),('player_highlight_leader.png','player_highlight_leader.png')]:
            with Image.open(APP/'assets'/actual) as a,Image.open(ROOT/'previews/approved-html/assets'/approved) as b:
                self.assertIsNone(ImageChops.difference(a.convert('RGBA'),b.convert('RGBA')).getbbox())

    def test_red_brakes_and_borderless_charge_masks(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local R=require('renderer');local S=require('settings');local T=require('telemetry')
          local r=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080);local t=T.new();t.ers=true;t.charge=0.5
          assert(r.c.brake.r==1 and r.c.brake.g<0.3 and r.c.brake.b<0.3)
          assert(r.chargeBg[1]=='assets/battery.png')
          local draw=r.draw;local count,fill
          r.draw=function(q,color,...)
            if q[1]=='assets/battery.png' then
              count=count+1
              if q~=r.chargeBg then fill=q end
            end
            draw(q,color,...)
          end
          count=0;ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
          r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
          assert(count==2 and fill[7].x==0.5 and fill[8].x==0.5)
          t.ers=false;count=0;ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
          r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow();assert(count==1)
        ''')

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
````

````python
import unittest
from headless import Harness

class GearMotionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_slide_and_continuous_reversal(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
          local G=require('gear_motion');local s=G.new()
          G.update(s,2,0,260);assert(s.position==2)
          local prev=2
          for i=1,15 do G.update(s,7,1/60,260);assert(s.position>=prev and s.position<=7);prev=s.position end
          local p,v=s.position,s.velocity
          G.update(s,1,0,260);assert(s.position==p and math.abs(s.velocity-v)<1e-10)
          for i=1,120 do G.update(s,1,1/60,260) end
          assert(s.position==1)
        """)

    def test_neutral_reverse_peak_scale_and_settle(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
          local G=require('gear_motion');local s=G.new();G.update(s,0,0,260)
          G.update(s,-1,0,260)
          for i=1,5 do G.update(s,-1,.025,260) end
          assert(s.letter=='N' and s.scale>1 and s.scale<1.3)
          for i=1,6 do G.update(s,-1,.025,260) end
          assert(s.letter=='R' and s.scale>1.29 and s.position==0)
          for i=1,11 do G.update(s,-1,.025,260) end
          assert(s.scale==1 and s.phase==nil)
          G.update(s,0,0,260)
          for i=1,11 do G.update(s,0,.025,260) end
          assert(s.letter=='N' and s.scale>1.29)
          G.update(s,-1,0,260)
          for i=1,40 do G.update(s,-1,.025,260) end
          assert(s.letter=='R' and s.scale==1)
        """)

    def test_layout_rebuild_preserves_motion(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
          local R=require('renderer');local new=R.new
          R.new=function(...) local r=new(...);local render=r.render
            r.render=function(t) observedPosition=t.gearPosition;observedLetter=t.slotLetter;render(t) end
            return r end
          uiState={windowSize=vec2(1920,1080)};ac.getUI=function() return uiState end
          ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=1,currentSessionIndex=0} end
          car={gear=2,rpm=2000,speedKmh=30,physicsAvailable=true,racePosition=1,
            driverName=function() return 'Driver' end}
          ac.getCar=function() return car end
        """)
        # Use live telemetry so the desired gear is controlled directly.
        h.lua.execute("ui.checkbox=function(label) return label=='Force demo telemetry' end")
        h.frame(0);h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        h.frame(0)
        h.lua.execute('car.gear=6');h.frame(.02)
        before=h.lua.globals().observedPosition
        self.assertGreater(before,2);self.assertLess(before,6)
        h.lua.execute('uiState.windowSize=vec2(1280,720)');h.frame(.02)
        self.assertGreater(h.lua.globals().observedPosition,before)
        self.assertLess(h.lua.globals().observedPosition,6)

    def test_duration_control_auto_saves(self):
        h=Harness();h.frame(0)
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(label,v) return label=='Gear animation' and 400 or v end;script.windowMain()")
        h.frame(.41)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['GEAR_ANIMATION_MS']),400)
````

````python
"""Run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v (requires lupa, Pillow)."""
import math
import unittest
from headless import Harness, APP

class TelemetryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.h=Harness(); self.lua=self.h.lua
        self.lua.execute("T=require('telemetry'); out=T.new()")

    def runlua(self,code): self.lua.execute(code)

    def test_mapping_and_no_speed_rpm_lag(self):
        self.runlua('''T.sample(out,{speedKmh=296.25,rpm=13250,gear=7,brake=1,gas=0.25,
          physicsAvailable=true,kersPresent=true,kersCharge=0.72,kersInput=0.88,
          kersCharging=true,kersButtonPressed=true,drsPresent=true,drsActive=true,drsAvailable=true},0.07,0.07)
          assert(out.speed==296.25 and out.rpm==13250 and out.gear==7)
          assert(math.abs(out.brake-(1-math.exp(-1)))<1e-12)
          assert(out.charge==0.72 and out.ersInput==0.88 and out.overtake and out.charging)
          assert(out.aeroActive and out.aeroAvailable)
        ''')

    def test_no_kers_and_no_faked_overtake(self):
        self.runlua('''T.sample(out,{speedKmh=100,rpm=8000,gear=4,gas=1,brake=0,
          kersPresent=false,kersCharge=1,kersInput=1,kersButtonPressed=true,drsPresent=false},0.016,0.07)
          assert(not out.ers and out.charge==0 and not out.overtake and not out.aeroActive)
          T.sample(out,{kersPresent=true,kersCharge=0.6,kersInput=1,gas=1,
          kersButtonPressed=false},0.016,0.07)
          assert(not out.overtake and out.ersInput==1)
        ''')

    def test_unavailable_physics(self):
        self.runlua('''T.sample(out,{physicsAvailable=false,speedKmh=200,rpm=9000,gear=5,
          gas=1,brake=1,kersPresent=true,kersCharge=1,drsPresent=true},1,0.07)
          assert(out.speed==200 and out.gear==5 and out.rawBrake==0 and out.rawThrottle==0)
          assert(not out.ers and not out.aeroPresent and not out.physics)
        ''')

    def test_nan_and_out_of_range(self):
        self.runlua('''T.sample(out,{speedKmh=0/0,rpm=math.huge,gear=-1,
          gas=5,brake=-1,kersPresent=true,kersCharge=3,kersInput=-4},0.016,0.07)
          assert(out.speed==0 and out.rpm==0 and out.gear==-1)
          assert(out.rawThrottle==1 and out.rawBrake==0 and out.charge==1 and out.ersInput==0)
        ''')

    def test_rows_p1_solo_empty_sparse_and_rank_order(self):
        self.runlua('''
          local p={index=0,driverName=function() return 'George Russell' end}
          local a={index=2,driverName=function() return 'Oliver Bearman' end}
          T.rows(out,p,1,function(i) return p end,'FULL')
          assert(out.solo and out.ahead.name=='' and out.player.position=='1')
          T.rows(out,p,0,function() return nil end,'FULL')
          assert(out.player.position=='--')
          T.rows(out,p,3,function(i) return ({[0]=a,[2]=p})[i] end,'CODE')
          assert(out.player.position=='3' and out.ahead.position=='1')
          assert(out.ahead.name=='BEA' and out.player.name=='RUS')
        ''')

    def test_names(self):
        self.runlua("""assert(T.name('Nico Hülkenberg','FULL')=='HULKENBERG')
          assert(T.name('  ','FULL')=='DRIVER')
          assert(T.name('A ReallyVeryLongSurnameWithMoreLetters','FULL'):len()==19)
          assert(T.name('周冠宇','FULL')=='???')""")

    def test_demo_full_ranges(self):
        vals=[]
        for i in range(1000):
            self.lua.globals().T.demo(self.lua.globals().out,i*.1,'FULL')
            o=self.lua.globals().out
            self.assertTrue(0<=o.brake<=1 and 0<=o.throttle<=1 and 0<=o.charge<=1)
            self.assertTrue(-1<=o.gear<=8)
            vals.append(o.gear)
        self.assertEqual(set(vals),set(range(-1,9)))

class IntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_lua_file_parses_in_lua51(self):
        h=Harness()
        loader=h.lua.eval('function(s) local f,e=loadstring(s); assert(f,e); return true end')
        for p in APP.glob('*.lua'): self.assertTrue(loader(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))

    def test_auto_demo_without_car_and_off(self):
        self.assertGreater(len(Harness(demo='AUTO').frame()),200)
        self.assertEqual(Harness(demo='OFF').frame(),[])

    def test_actual_app_live_solo_no_kers(self):
        h=Harness(demo='AUTO')
        h.lua.execute('''
          local c={index=0,speedKmh=296,rpm=13200,gear=7,gas=1,brake=0,
            physicsAvailable=true,kersPresent=false,drsPresent=false,
            driverName=function() return 'Test Player' end}
          ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=1,currentSessionIndex=0} end
          ac.getCar=function() return c end
          ac.getSession=function() return {leaderboard={}} end
        ''')
        self.assertGreater(len(h.frame()),200)
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()

    def test_resolution_curve_theme_opacity_and_asset_bounds(self):
        for w,h,curve,theme in [(1920,1080,0,'TEAL'),(1920,1080,1.6,'ICE'),
                               (2560,1440,1,'AMBER'),(1280,720,1,'TEAL'),(3440,1440,1,'TEAL')]:
            a=Harness(w,h,overrides={'CURVE':curve,'THEME':theme,'OPACITY':0.6})
            commands=a.frame()
            for texture,points,tint,uv in commands:
                self.assertTrue((APP/texture).is_file(),texture)
                self.assertTrue(all(math.isfinite(n) for p in points for n in p))
                self.assertTrue(all(0<=n<=1 for p in uv for n in p))
                self.assertTrue(0<=tint[3]<=0.6+1e-6)
                self.assertTrue(all(-1<=p[0]<=w+1 and -1<=p[1]<=h+1 for p in points))

    def test_live_to_demo_transition(self):
        h=Harness(demo='AUTO')
        h.lua.execute('''
          local c={index=0,speedKmh=90,rpm=5000,gear=3,gas=0.5,brake=0,
            driverName=function() return 'Solo Player' end}
          ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=1,currentSessionIndex=0} end
          ac.getCar=function() return c end
        ''')
        self.assertGreater(len(h.frame()),200)
        h.lua.execute("ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=0} end")
        for i in range(100): self.assertGreater(len(h.frame()),200)

if __name__=='__main__': unittest.main()
````

````python
import unittest
from headless import Harness

class LeaderboardMotionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_vertical_swap_reversal_and_solo_fade(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
          local M=require('leaderboard_motion');local s=M.new()
          local t={solo=false,leaderFirst=false,ahead={position='1',name='BEARMAN'}}
          M.update(s,t,0,450);assert(s.p.x==30.5 and s.o.x==-49)
          t.leaderFirst=true;M.update(s,t,.03,450);assert(s.p.x<30.5)
          local x,v=s.p.x,s.p.v;t.leaderFirst=false;M.update(s,t,0,450)
          assert(s.p.x==x and math.abs(s.p.v-v)<1e-10)
          for i=1,120 do M.update(s,t,1/60,450) end
          assert(s.p.x==30.5 and s.o.x==-49)
          t.solo=true;t.ahead={position='',name=''}
          M.update(s,t,.03,450);assert(s.opponent.name=='BEARMAN')
          for i=1,120 do M.update(s,t,1/60,450) end
          assert(s.p.x==-11.5 and s.opponentAlpha==0)
          t.solo=false;t.leaderFirst=true;t.ahead={position='2',name='RUSSELL'}
          for i=1,120 do M.update(s,t,1/60,450) end
          assert(s.p.x==-53.5 and s.o.x==30.5 and s.opponentAlpha==1)
        """)

    def test_crossover_fades_opponent_and_shared_highlight_projection(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute("""
          local M=require('leaderboard_motion');local S=require('settings');local R=require('renderer');local T=require('telemetry')
          local t=T.new();t.solo=false;t.leaderFirst=false;t.ahead.name='BEARMAN'
          local m=M.new();M.update(m,t,0,450)
          m.p.x=0;m.o.x=0;M.update(m,t,0,450);assert(m.opponentAlpha==0)
          m.p.x=-15;t.leaderboardMotion=m
          local r=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080);local draw=r.draw;local count=0
          r.draw=function(q,...)
            if q[1]=='assets/player_highlight.png' then
              local p=r.point(-830+512*count/12,m.p.x-18.5)
              assert(math.abs(q[2].x-p.x)<1e-8 and math.abs(q[2].y-p.y)<1e-8)
              assert(q[6].y==104/192 and q[8].y==172/192);count=count+1
            end
            draw(q,...)
          end
          ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
          r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow();assert(count==12)
        """)

    def test_duration_control_auto_saves(self):
        h=Harness();h.frame(0)

        h.frame(.41)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['LEADERBOARD_ANIMATION_MS']),650)

    def test_live_resize_preserves_transition(self):
        h=Harness(demo='OFF');h.lua.execute("""
          local R=require('renderer');local new=R.new
          R.new=function(...) local r=new(...);local render=r.render
            r.render=function(t) observed=t.leaderboardMotion.p.x;render(t) end;return r end
          uiState={windowSize=vec2(1920,1080)};ac.getUI=function() return uiState end
          ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=2,currentSessionIndex=0,raceSessionType=3} end
          p={index=0,racePosition=2,gear=1,physicsAvailable=true,driverName=function() return 'Player' end}
          b={index=1,racePosition=1,driverName=function() return 'Bot' end}
          ac.getCar=function(i) return i==0 and p or b end
        """)
        h.frame(0);self.assertEqual(h.lua.globals().observed,30.5)
        h.lua.execute('p.racePosition=1;b.racePosition=2');h.frame(.25)
        x=h.lua.globals().observed

        h.lua.execute('uiState.windowSize=vec2(1280,720)');h.frame(.02)

        self.assertGreater(h.lua.globals().observed,-53.5)
````

## tests/test_mouse_drag.py

````python
import unittest
from headless import Harness

class MouseDragTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setup_drag(self, **kwargs):
        h=Harness(**kwargs)
        h.lua.execute('''
          windows={}; captures=0; held=false; dx=0; dy=0
          local begin=ui.beginTransparentWindow
          ui.beginTransparentWindow=function(id,p,s,pad,inputs)
            windows[#windows+1]={id=id,inputs=inputs}; begin(id,p,s,pad,inputs)
          end
          ui.itemActive=function() return held end
          ui.mouseDelta=function() return vec2(dx,dy) end
          ui.captureMouse=function() captures=captures+1 end
          local R=require('renderer'); local new=R.new
          R.new=function(...) local r=new(...); dragInfo=r.drag; return r end
        ''')
        h.frame(0)
        return h

    def toggle(self,h):
        h.lua.execute('''
          ui.checkbox=function(label) return label=='Drag HUD with mouse' end
          script.windowMain()
          ui.checkbox=function() return false end
        ''')

    def test_temporary_mode_only_handle_accepts_input(self):
        h=self.setup_drag(); self.assertEqual(len(h.lua.globals().windows),1)
        self.toggle(h); h.frame(0)
        self.assertEqual(h.lua.globals().windows[3].id,'HaloHUD:dragHandle')
        self.assertTrue(h.lua.globals().windows[3].inputs)
        self.toggle(h); h.lua.execute('windows={}')
        h.frame(0); self.assertEqual(len(h.lua.globals().windows),1)
        self.assertFalse(h.lua.globals().windows[1].inputs)
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)

    def test_fitted_scale_motion_and_autosave(self):
        for width,height,scale in ((1920,1080,1),(1280,720,.5),(2560,1440,1.5)):
            with self.subTest(width=width,scale=scale):
                h=self.setup_drag(width=width,height=height,overrides={'SCALE':scale})
                self.toggle(h); info=h.lua.globals().dragInfo
                x,y,s=info.x,info.y,info.scale
                h.lua.execute('held=true;dx=20;dy=12'); h.frame(0)
                self.assertEqual(h.saves,0) # initial click must not jump
                h.frame(0); h.frame(0) # rebuild, following stationary frame below
                # Two movement frames have now applied.
                h.lua.execute('dx=0;dy=0;held=false'); h.frame(.41)
                self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)
                expected_x=min(info.maxX,max(info.minX,x+40/s))
                expected_y=min(info.maxY,max(info.minY,y+24/s))
                self.assertAlmostEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['X_OFFSET']),expected_x)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['Y_OFFSET']),expected_y)

    def test_edge_drag_reverses_without_dead_zone(self):
        h=self.setup_drag(overrides={'X_OFFSET':960,'Y_OFFSET':540})
        self.toggle(h); h.lua.execute('held=true'); h.frame(0)
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)
        h.lua.execute('dx=10000;dy=10000'); h.frame(0); h.frame(0)
        info=h.lua.globals().dragInfo
        self.assertAlmostEqual(info.x,info.maxX)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(info.y,info.maxY)
        h.lua.execute('dx=-12;dy=-8'); h.frame(0)
        h.lua.execute('dx=0;dy=0;held=false'); h.frame(.41)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['X_OFFSET']),info.maxX-12/info.scale)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['Y_OFFSET']),info.maxY-8/info.scale)

    def test_hidden_resets_drag_and_reset_exits_edit_mode(self):
        h=self.setup_drag(); self.toggle(h)
        h.lua.execute('hudUI=ac.getUI(); ac.getUI=function() return hudUI end;held=true')
        h.frame(0)
        h.lua.execute('hudUI.appsHidden=true;windows={};dx=40'); h.frame(0)
        self.assertEqual(len(h.lua.globals().windows),0)
        h.lua.execute('hudUI.appsHidden=false'); h.frame(0)
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)
        h.lua.execute('ui.button=function(label) return label=="Reset to defaults" end;script.windowMain();windows={}')
````

````python
import unittest

class RacePositionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rank_changes_look_up_ahead_by_live_position(self):
        h=Harness()
        h.lua.execute('''local T=require('telemetry');local o=T.new()
          local p={index=0,racePosition=3,driverName=function() return 'Player Test' end}
          local a={index=1,racePosition=1,driverName=function() return 'AI Leader' end}
          local b={index=2,racePosition=2,driverName=function() return 'AI Ahead' end}
          local cars={[0]=p,a,b};local lookup=function(i) return cars[i] end
          T.raceRows(o,p,3,lookup,'FULL')
          assert(o.player.position=='3' and o.ahead.position=='2' and o.ahead.name=='AHEAD')
          p.racePosition=2;b.racePosition=3
          T.raceRows(o,p,3,lookup,'FULL')
          assert(o.player.position=='2' and o.ahead.name=='LEADER')
          p.racePosition=1;a.racePosition=2
          T.raceRows(o,p,3,lookup,'FULL');assert(o.leaderFirst and o.ahead.name=='LEADER' and o.ahead.position=='2')
          p.racePosition=3;b.racePosition=1
          T.raceRows(o,p,3,lookup,'CODE')
          assert(o.player.position=='3' and o.ahead.name=='LEA')
        ''')

    def test_missing_rank_opponent_and_solo_clear_stale_values(self):

          local p={index=0,racePosition=1,driverName=function() return 'Player Test' end}
          T.raceRows(o,p,4,function() return nil end,'FULL');assert(o.leaderFirst and o.ahead.name=='UNAVAILABLE')
          p.racePosition=4;T.raceRows(o,p,4,function() return nil end,'FULL')
          assert(o.player.position=='4' and o.ahead.name=='UNAVAILABLE')
          p.racePosition=0;T.raceRows(o,p,4,function() return nil end,'FULL')
          assert(o.player.position=='--' and o.ahead.name=='UNAVAILABLE')
          T.raceRows(o,p,1,function() return nil end,'FULL')
          assert(o.solo and o.player.position=='1' and o.ahead.name=='')
        ''')

    def test_app_ignores_player_first_board_in_bot_race(self):
        h=Harness(demo='AUTO');messages=[]
        h.lua.globals().recordText=messages.append
        h.lua.execute('''
          player={index=0,racePosition=3,driverName=function() return 'Player Test' end}
          leader={index=1,racePosition=1,driverName=function() return 'AI Leader' end}
          ahead={index=2,racePosition=2,driverName=function() return 'AI Ahead' end}
          ac.getSim=function() return {carsCount=3,currentSessionIndex=0,raceSessionType=3} end
          ac.getSession=function() return {type=3,leaderboard={[0]={car=player}}} end
          ac.getCar=function(i) return ({[0]=player,[1]=leader,[2]=ahead})[i] end
          ui.text=recordText
        ''')
        h.frame(0.25);h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertIn('Position 3 | Ahead 2 AHEAD',messages)
        messages.clear()
        h.lua.execute('player.racePosition=2;ahead.racePosition=3')
        h.frame(0.25);h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertIn('Position 2 | Ahead 1 LEADER',messages)
````

````python
import unittest
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('release_notes',ROOT/'source/extract_release_notes.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)

class ReleaseNoteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_current_version_only(self):
        notes=module.extract((ROOT/'README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'v1.10.0')
        self.assertIn('vertical leaderboard',notes)
        self.assertNotIn('### 1.9.0',notes)
        self.assertNotIn('## Maintainers',notes)

    def test_missing_empty_and_duplicate_entries_fail(self):
        for text in ['## Changelog\n### 1.0.0\n', '## Changelog\n### 2.0.0\n- Other\n',
                     '## Changelog\n### 1.0.0\n- A\n### 1.0.0\n- B\n']:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): module.extract(text,'v1.0.0')

    def test_code_fence_and_changelog_scope(self):
        text='### 1.0.0\nOutside\n## Changelog\n### 1.0.0 — Initial\n- A\n```md\n### 2.0.0\n```\n- B\n## Help\nEnd'
        notes=module.extract(text,'1.0.0')
        self.assertIn('- B',notes)
        self.assertNotIn('Outside',notes)
        self.assertNotIn('End',notes)

    def test_exact_version_boundary(self):
        text='## Changelog\n### 1.10.0 — New\n- Ten\n### 1.1.0 — Old\n- One\n'
        self.assertEqual(module.extract(text,'v1.1.0'),'- One\n')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): module.extract(text,'bad tag')
````

````python
import unittest, itertools, json
from headless import Harness, ROOT

class EnergyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.h=Harness(); self.l=self.h.lua
        self.l.execute("T=require('telemetry'); S=require('settings'); cfg=S.read(nil); o=T.new(); c={kersPresent=true,kersCharge=0.5,kersCharging=true,kersInput=1,brake=0.8}")
    def runlua(self,s):self.l.execute(s)
    def test_positive_rate_and_damping(self):
        self.runlua('''cfg.recoveryFallback='EMPTY'
          T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          c.kersCharge=0.505;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(math.abs(o.rawRecharge-0.5)<1e-9)
          assert(math.abs(o.deploy-(1-math.exp(-0.2/0.07)))<1e-9)
          c.kersCharging=false;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
        ''')
    def test_unmeasurable_full_charge_and_negative(self):
        self.runlua('''T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0.8)
          c.kersCharge=0.49;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
          c.kersCharge=1;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
          c.kersCharge=nil;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0.8)
          cfg.recoveryFallback='EMPTY';T.energy(o,0.1,cfg);assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
        ''')
    def test_quantized_charge_timeout_and_long_frame(self):
        self.runlua('''cfg.recoveryFallback='EMPTY'
          T.sample(o,c,0.05,0.07);T.energy(o,0.05,cfg)
          for i=1,3 do T.sample(o,c,0.05,0.07);T.energy(o,0.05,cfg) end
          c.kersCharge=0.51;T.sample(o,c,0.05,0.07);T.energy(o,0.05,cfg)
          assert(math.abs(o.rawRecharge-0.5)<1e-9)
          for i=1,6 do T.sample(o,c,0.05,0.07);T.energy(o,0.05,cfg) end
          assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
          c.kersCharge=0.6;T.sample(o,c,2,0.07);T.energy(o,2,cfg);assert(o.rawRecharge==0)
        ''')
    def test_no_ers_default_empty_opt_in_drs(self):
        self.runlua('''c.kersPresent=false;c.drsPresent=true;c.drsActive=true
          cfg.noKersDeploy='EMPTY'
          T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.deploy==0 and o.recharge==0)
          cfg.noKersDeploy='DRS';T.energy(o,0.1,cfg);assert(o.rawDeploy==1 and o.deploy>0)
          c.drsActive=false;c.p2pStatus=42;cfg.noKersDeploy='DRS_OR_P2P'
          T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg);assert(o.rawDeploy==0)
          cfg.p2pActiveStatus=42;T.energy(o,0.1,cfg);assert(o.rawDeploy==1)
          c.physicsAvailable=false;T.sample(o,c,0.1,0.07);T.energy(o,0.1,cfg)
          assert(o.deploy==0 and o.recharge==0)
        ''')

class LayoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_digit_ink_centered_equal_advances(self):
        g=json.loads((ROOT/'source/glyphs.json').read_text())['labels']['glyphs']
        widths=[]
        for c in '0123456789':
            d=g[str(ord(c))];widths.append(d['advance'])
            self.assertAlmostEqual(d['x']+d['w']/2,d['advance']/2,places=3)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(widths)),1)
    def test_live_sliders_save_reset_and_other_options(self):
        h=Harness(overrides={'UNITS':'MPH','THEME':'AMBER','ENABLED':1})
        old=h.frame()
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(label,v) if label=='HUD scale' then return 0.7 elseif label=='Center dial scale' then return 1.3 end return v end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertNotEqual(old,h.frame())
        h.lua.execute("ui.button=function(label) return label=='Save config.ini' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['SCALE']),0.7)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['DIAL_SCALE']),1.3)
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['UNITS'],'MPH')
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['THEME'],'AMBER')
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(_,v) return v end;ui.button=function(label) return label=='Reset to defaults' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,1) # Reset is a preview until Save
        h.lua.execute("ui.button=function(label) return label=='Save config.ini' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['SCALE']),1)
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['UNITS'],'KMH')
    def test_region_scale_extremes_fit_and_offsets(self):
        for curve in (0,1.6):
            for scales in itertools.product((0.5,1.5),repeat=4):
                opts=dict(zip(('LEFT_SCALE','DIAL_SCALE','MODULE_SCALE','RIGHT_SCALE'),scales))
                opts.update(CURVE=curve,SCALE=1.5,X_OFFSET=960,Y_OFFSET=-540,OUTER_ARC=1)
                commands=Harness(1280,720,overrides=opts).frame()
                self.assertTrue(commands)
                for _,pts,_,_ in commands:
                    self.assertTrue(all(0<=x<=1280 and 0<=y<=720 for x,y in pts),(opts,pts))
    def test_false_enabled_persists(self):
        self.assertEqual(Harness(overrides={'ENABLED':0}).frame(),[])

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
````

````python
import unittest
from headless import Harness

class Version13Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def renderer(self):
        h=Harness()
        h.lua.execute('''R=require('renderer');S=require('settings');T=require('telemetry')
          cfg=S.read(nil);r=R.new(cfg,1920,1080);t=T.new()
          texts={};local original=r.text
          r.text=function(str,u,v,...)
            texts[#texts+1]={text=tostring(str),u=u,v=v}
            original(str,u,v,...)
          end
          function capture()
            texts={}
            ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
            r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
          end
        ''')
        return h

    def test_unpadded_speed_both_unit_orders(self):
        h=self.renderer();g=h.lua.globals()
        for units in ('KMH','MPH'):
            for kmh in (0,1,9,17,99,108,184,296):
                g.cfg.units=units;g.t.speed=kmh;g.capture()
                values={row.v:row.text for row in g.texts.values() if row.u==0 and row.v in (-99,57)}
                mph=int(kmh*0.6213711922+0.5)
                self.assertEqual(values[-99],str(kmh if units=='KMH' else mph))
                self.assertEqual(values[57],str(mph if units=='KMH' else kmh))

    def test_sixteen_bottom_up_pedal_segments(self):
        h=self.renderer();g=h.lua.globals()
        self.assertEqual(len(g.r.pedals[1]),16);self.assertEqual(len(g.r.pedals[2]),16)
        # All 16 are inside the unchanged module envelope and ordered bottom-up.
        for side in (1,2):
            centers=[]
            for i in range(1,17):
                q=g.r.pedals[side][i]
                centers.append(sum(q[j].y for j in range(2,6))/4)
            self.assertTrue(all(a>b for a,b in zip(centers,centers[1:])))

    def test_inactive_slashes_active_icon_unchanged(self):
        h=self.renderer();h.lua.execute('''local A=require('aero')
          local idle=A.poses(0);local active=A.poses(1)
          assert(idle[1].angle==idle[2].angle and idle[1].angle<0)
          assert(active[1].angle==0 and active[2].angle==0)
          assert(active[1].length==32 and active[2].length==51)
          assert(active[1].x+373.5==364 and active[2].x+373.5==373.5)
          assert(active[1].y==-11 and active[2].y==2)
        ''')

    def test_solo_centered_row_transition_and_partial_board(self):
        h=self.renderer();g=h.lua.globals()
        h.lua.execute('''local p={index=0,driverName=function() return 'Solo Driver' end}
          T.rows(t,p,0,function() return nil end,'FULL',1)
          assert(t.solo and t.ahead.name=='' and t.player.position=='1')
          capture()
        ''')
        names={row.text:row.v for row in g.texts.values()}
        self.assertEqual(names['DRIVER'],-11.5)
        self.assertNotIn('CLEAR TRACK',names)
        self.assertIn('assets/player_highlight_solo.png',[c[0] for c in h.commands])
        self.assertNotIn('assets/player_highlight.png',[c[0] for c in h.commands])
        # A one-entry board while other cars exist must not imply solo.
        h.commands=[]
        h.lua.execute('''local p={index=0,driverName=function() return 'Solo Driver' end}
          T.rows(t,p,1,function() return p end,'FULL',4)
          assert(not t.solo);capture()
        ''')
        self.assertIn('assets/player_highlight.png',[c[0] for c in h.commands])
        self.assertEqual({row.text:row.v for row in g.texts.values()}['DRIVER'],30.5)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
````

````python
import unittest
from headless import Harness

class Version14Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_inactive_label_boxes(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local R=require('renderer');local S=require('settings');local T=require('telemetry')
          local r=R.new(S.read(nil),1920,1080);local t=T.new();t.ers=true
          local rect=r.rect;local boxes
          r.rect=function(u,v,w,h,color,...)
            if u==-112 and w==224 and h==27 then boxes[v]=color end
            rect(u,v,w,h,color,...)
          end
          for _,deploy in ipairs({0.5,0.51}) do
            boxes={};t.deploy=deploy
            ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
            r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
            assert(math.abs(boxes[14].r-65/255)<1e-9)
            if deploy<=0.5 then assert(math.abs(boxes[-18].r-65/255)<1e-9)
            else assert(boxes[-18]==r.c.green) end
          end
        ''')

    def test_release_flushes_pending_changes(self):
        h=Harness();h.frame()
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(label,v) if label=='HUD scale' then return 0.75 end return v end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)
        h.lua.globals().releaseCallback()
        self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['SCALE']),0.75)

    def test_rpm_and_deploy_boundaries(self):
        h=Harness();h.lua.execute('''local R=require('renderer');local T=require('telemetry');local S=require('settings')
          local c=S.read(nil);c.revLimit=8000
          local r=R.new(c,1920,1080);local t=T.new();t.ers=true
          local draw=r.draw;local text=r.text
          local fill,labels
          r.draw=function(q,color,...)
            if q==r.rpm[1] then fill=color end
            draw(q,color,...)
          end
          r.text=function(s,u,v,size,color,...)
            labels[tostring(s)]=color
            text(s,u,v,size,color,...)
          end
          for _,rpm in ipairs({10000,10999,11000,11001,13000}) do
            for _,deploy in ipairs({0.49,0.5,0.51}) do
              for _,overtake in ipairs({false,true}) do
                t.rpm=rpm;t.deploy=deploy;t.overtake=overtake;labels={}
                ui.beginTransparentWindow('test',vec2(),vec2(1920,1080),true,false)
                r.render(t);ui.endTransparentWindow()
                assert((fill.r>0.9)==(rpm>11000))
                assert(labels.OVERTAKE==r.c.dim)
                assert(labels.BOOST==(deploy>0.5 and r.c.white or r.c.dim))
              end
            end
          end
        ''')

    def test_debounced_save_even_if_controls_closed_and_hud_disabled(self):
        h=Harness();h.frame()
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(label,v) if label=='HUD scale' then return 0.8 end return v end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        h.frame(0.2);self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)
        # A later change restarts the debounce rather than writing every drag frame.
        h.lua.execute("ui.checkbox=function(label) return label=='Show HUD' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        h.frame(0.2);self.assertEqual(h.saves,0)
        h.frame(0.21);self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)
        self.assertEqual(float(h.ini['HUD']['SCALE']),0.8)
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['ENABLED'],'0')
        h.frame(1);self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)

    def test_demo_profile_and_arc_persist_and_reload(self):
        h=Harness(demo='AUTO');h.frame()
        h.lua.execute("ui.checkbox=function(label) return label=='Force demo telemetry' or label=='Outer arc' or label=='Measure Lua CPU time' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain();h.frame(0.41)
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['DEMO'],'ON')
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['PROFILE_CPU'],'1')
        self.assertEqual(h.ini['HUD']['OUTER_ARC'],'1')
        h.lua.execute("ui.checkbox=function() return false end;ui.button=function(label) return label=='Reload config.ini' end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        states={}
        h.lua.globals().remember=lambda label,value:states.update({label:value})
        h.lua.execute("ui.button=function() return false end;ui.checkbox=function(label,v) remember(label,v);return false end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertTrue(states['Force demo telemetry']);self.assertTrue(states['Outer arc'])
        self.assertTrue(states['Measure Lua CPU time'])

    def test_save_errors_are_visible_and_retried(self):
        h=Harness();h.frame()
        h.lua.execute("ui.slider=function(label,v) if label=='HUD scale' then return 0.9 end return v end; py_ini_save=function() error('write failure fixture') end")
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain();h.frame(0.41)
        messages=[];h.lua.globals().ui.textWrapped=messages.append
        h.lua.globals().script.windowMain()
        self.assertTrue(any('write failure fixture' in m for m in messages))
        h.lua.globals().py_ini_save=h.ini_save
        h.frame(2.1);self.assertEqual(h.saves,1)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
````
